Shen Nanzhou rested his cheek in his hand and smiled lightly. "Senior Sister, what do you think?"

Ye Wanwan furrowed her brow. A suspicion was forming, but she did not want to accept it...

Bai Jian and the others had been pulled in here as well.

"Wanwan, you were not quite like this with me before."

That low, deep voice came without warning. Ye Wanwan's eyes snapped wide open. She stared at Shen Nanzhou in disbelief. "You..."

"I'm alive too." Shen Nanzhou looked at Ye Wanwan, and said with a quiet laugh, "Happy?"

Ye Wanwan: "..."

She turned and ran.

chapters.title: I Don't Believe You
chapters.content:
But two steps out, the blue silk thread coiled around her waist.

Ye Wanwan raised her hand to tear it away and run — but Shen Nanzhou said lightly from behind, "If you snap it, Senior Sister Bai and the others are finished."

Ye Wanwan spun back, eyes cold, fixed on Shen Nanzhou.

She let the dream silk drag her to stand before him.

One standing, one sitting.

Shen Nanzhou gave the silk a light tug. Ye Wanwan was forced to half-crouch, meeting his gaze. She said coldly, "I don't believe you."

Shen Nanzhou raised an eyebrow. "Why don't you believe me?"

"If you truly had memories of your past life, you would have killed me already." Even bound as she was, Ye Wanwan raised one finger and boldly lifted Shen Nanzhou's chin, saying calmly:

"Because at the very end — I betrayed you."

Shen Nanzhou's gaze met Ye Wanwan's.

Their eyes locked.

Ye Wanwan's gaze was clear. Shen Nanzhou's was deep.

She was not afraid of death.

Because in a fight between the two of them right now, neither outcome was guaranteed. Against the Shen Nanzhou of the past life she'd had no real chance. But this time was different.

At worst, Ye Wanwan could use the dream spirit's abilities to kill this person.

One less Junior Brother.

Clean up the problem early.

The spiritual energy around Ye Wanwan was stirring with increasing strength. If not for the dream silk, the young woman would have broken free long since. And her eyes did not back down in the slightest.

After a long moment, the dream silk was released. Shen Nanzhou spoke. "Senior Sister, what are you saying? I don't understand any of it. What past life, what next life — perhaps the dream realm has confused you."

"We only have this one life." Shen Nanzhou smiled.

Ye Wanwan stared into his eyes, unable to tell what game he was playing. But she raised her hand and pressed the dream silk. "Release it."

He released half of it, but the other half remained.

Ye Wanwan could stand up, but not leave.

Shen Nanzhou gave a quiet sigh. "Senior Sister, I am rather powerless right now."

Ye Wanwan smiled. "Don't make me slap you."

Shen Nanzhou did not react to that. "I genuinely cannot move. Look carefully."

Ye Wanwan heard this and looked at the space around Shen Nanzhou.

From him as the centre, blue threads extended behind him. In the space at his back, the entire expanse was dream silk — threads wound over and under and around each other, three layers on top and three below, dense and tangled as a web gone wrong.

And the creature trapped within the web was Shen Nanzhou.

Ye Wanwan drew a sharp breath.

Even Xingze and the dream spirit were speechless.

So much of it.

"How did you accumulate this much dream silk?" Ye Wanwan's mind turned quickly. "Did you pull everyone in the realm into this?"

Shen Nanzhou looked as though the situation were deeply inconvenient. "Not quite that many."

Just as Ye Wanwan exhaled in relief, Shen Nanzhou's voice rose at the end. "Though the dream realm seems to be able to cover the entire secret realm, and I... extended it a little too far without meaning to. Senior Sister, what do we do now?"

What do we do — kill you, and the problem is solved.

Ye Wanwan said in a ragged voice, "What exactly did you do just now?"

"Not much — I just accidentally broke a formation." Shen Nanzhou sounded entirely innocent, with that friendly smile still on his face. "I didn't do anything wrong, did I?"

Ye Wanwan clenched her fist, held herself back for a very long time, and managed not to throw that punch.

"Release it."

Shen Nanzhou blinked innocently.

Ye Wanwan turned to look at the lantern. "Release it!"

The dream spirit immediately got to work. This much dream silk was beyond its ability to fully untangle, but the dozen or so threads on Ye Wanwan — those it could manage. With some effort, Ye Wanwan was freed.

Shen Nanzhou's eyes followed Ye Wanwan all the while.

Ye Wanwan held the lantern and examined the dream silk. The blue threads had light flowing through them, carrying within them all the emotions and desires of every person inside.

All the cultivators in the entire Dream Illusion secret realm — all their dreams were here.

If she was right, everyone was currently trapped inside their dreams. And quite possibly many of them could not tell whether they were dreaming or awake, and might even be fighting within the dream world.

Ye Wanwan looked sideways at Shen Nanzhou.

Whether or not he had memories of his past life, Shen Nanzhou's approach to cultivators remained the same as always — ruthless and total.

"Where are Senior Sister and the others?"

"I don't know." Shen Nanzhou smiled innocently. "There is too much of it."

"Can it be untangled?"

Shen Nanzhou raised his brow. "No."

"There really is too much," the dream spirit said, hissing in a sharp breath. "And this young man has tangled everything together. To sort it out would take me three to five years."

Three to five years?

The Dream Illusion realm only stayed open for one month!

And the entire secret realm could not hold on that much longer either.

With what Shen Nanzhou had done here, the collapse outside was surely accelerating.

Ye Wanwan tried to start untangling them herself — but quickly found that it was hopeless. The threads were such a complete tangle that she could not tell whose was whose. If she accidentally pulled the wrong ones — Bai Jian's...

Ye Wanwan closed her eyes. She could not think about that.

She withdrew her hand, turned, and walked toward Shen Nanzhou.

Shen Nanzhou had been watching her every move. When he saw her return, he raised an eyebrow slightly.

"Your dream," Ye Wanwan said coldly. "What does it take to get out of it?"

Shen Nanzhou had not expected the young woman to think of that. He gave a low laugh, but answered honestly. "I don't know."

"Senior Sister has been inside my dream. What do you think — do I have a chance of getting out?"

He studied Ye Wanwan with an amused expression.

"Yes," Ye Wanwan said flatly.

Shen Nanzhou paused.

Ye Wanwan set down the lantern and sat across from him. "Take my hand. Enter the dream together."

Shen Nanzhou furrowed his brow, as though weighing the truth of what she was saying.

Ye Wanwan said coldly, "If this situation is not broken, we both die."

"Mm, having Senior Sister die alongside me — I could just about accept that."

Ye Wanwan gave a cold laugh. "Is that so?"

Of course it was not.

Shen Nanzhou also wanted to live.

But there was no other option. Because only Ye Wanwan could move freely through Shen Nanzhou's dream without being influenced by it.

"Very well — I will have to trouble Senior Sister to look after me." Shen Nanzhou extended a finger. A blue light flowed and sank into the space between Ye Wanwan's brows.

This time, he pulled her in as a dreamer alongside him.

Ye Wanwan opened her eyes.

Still the night the family was killed.

Still three-year-old Shen Nanzhou.

As though there was no way to leave, no matter what.

But this time, someone was also with the child. Ye Wanwan stood beside the boy and watched him search through the bodies for his family. Then she turned and went inside the main hall, found Shen Nanzhou's parents among the people there, and carried them out.

She set them down before Shen Nanzhou.

"What you wanted."

Three-year-old Shen Nanzhou went still.

"If you want to cry, then cry."

The boy did not cry. Even with his eyes red, the tears did not fall. Ye Wanwan watched him wipe away the blood on his parents' bodies. Her gaze moved toward the front gate.

The boy noticed it too, with a trace of resistance.

Ye Wanwan thought of what she had seen earlier — him running and jumping back into the well.

"You don't want to go to Tianyi Sect?"

The boy looked up at Ye Wanwan. In that moment, she saw a flash of something sharp in his eyes.

He did not want to go.

chapters.title: A Worthy Opponent!
chapters.content:
Ye Wanwan did not press further.

There was no time.

She brought the boy down into the well. In the narrow opening, the two of them pressed close together. Ye Wanwan held the water current beneath him, not letting him fall.

The boy watched Ye Wanwan, without moving.

Ye Wanwan looked back at him.

Would Shen Nanzhou inside the dream have memories of before?

Should she... do something?

After all, Shen Nanzhou was still very vulnerable right now. Setting a restriction of some kind would not be difficult.

But then she thought of Bai Jian and the others still outside, and she did not dare take the risk.

Let it go.

Footsteps sounded at the mouth of the well. Someone came into the residence to search. Unless her memory was wrong, Tianyi Sect's people should have been first.

And then...

Demonic energy!

A sweeping wave of demonic energy, vast and full of malice.

In moments, a blood mist condensed from demonic energy covered the mouth of the well, coiling around Shen Nanzhou's body and pulling the boy upward.

Ye Wanwan watched him look back at her with impassive eyes, no expression at all. But in the moment he passed the mouth of the well, Ye Wanwan reached out and grabbed him.

The three-year-old Shen Nanzhou's eyes finally showed a change.

She dragged the child and plunged to the bottom of the well.

The well water lifted at her command, formed into a mass, and shot upward — replacing Shen Nanzhou, who should have been swept away by the blood mist. And then Ye Wanwan, pulling Shen Nanzhou, burst upward in the next instant.

She called out loudly, "Daoist, save us!"

The elder who had come through the gate saw the blood mist at once and struck out with a sword condensed from his energy. "Audacious demon tribe — you dare run rampant in the mortal world!"

Ye Wanwan did not hesitate. Holding the boy, she simply ran.

She ran out of the Shen family residence, out of the street, out of the city, out of the range of the fighting cultivators — until she reached a place that was beyond the reach of Shen Nanzhou's dream. Then she looked down at the boy in her arms.

"How is it?"

"We're out."

Shen Nanzhou looked at the young woman, still slightly dazed.

"See? Just that simple."

"Many things are just that simple."

"As long as you stop caring, things resolve themselves. As long as you reach out a hand to one person, you can escape the nightmare." Ye Wanwan looked at Shen Nanzhou — the three-year-old child, still with the roundness of infancy, a chubby face, large clear black-and-white eyes, a stubborn endurance within them. But now they were full of confusion, as though trying to understand what she was saying.

Ye Wanwan gathered her thoughts. "Let's go."

The dream was not over yet.

Her solution for breaking this deadlock was to build this person — a new dream.

A fork in the road that branched away from the night the family was massacred.

Ye Wanwan chose for this young man a path he had never once considered — one where Shen Nanzhou, from childhood, was responsible for supporting Ye Wanwan.

Shen Nanzhou: "..."

"Junior Brother, ability is the measure of one's standing. You must work hard so that Senior Sister can live well."

Shen Nanzhou was half convinced, half doubtful — but under Ye Wanwan's insistence, he decisively enlisted in the army.

Ye Wanwan walked alongside him, never interfering. She only watched as he rose from a common foot soldier to a young general. Then she pointed out: "Junior Brother — you must not be too heavy on the killing. Otherwise, how will you cultivate in the future?"

"What use is cultivation?"

"No use. But it sounds prestigious."

"What if I cultivate the demonic path?"

"Then Junior Brother had better hide it well — just don't get caught."

"...I thought Senior Sister would tell me not to."

"Everyone has their own path to walk. Senior Sister will not interfere with yours."

"Then what path does Senior Sister walk?"

"Me? I walk the righteous path. Whatever path it may be." Ye Wanwan looked at twelve-year-old Shen Nanzhou, laughing quietly with self-assurance. "Immortal or demon or spirit — whatever path I walk is the righteous path."

Shen Nanzhou looked at her, then sat beside her in meditation.

This dream had no massacre night. No great immortal-demon war. Only Ye Wanwan deliberately taking Shen Nanzhou to wander the mortal world — but once Shen Nanzhou broke through to golden core and his identity was exposed, he was, predictably, hunted.

Ye Wanwan: "?"

She had hidden him this carefully and someone still found out?

Could this young man not just live out one peaceful lifetime?

Shen Nanzhou looked at her, his gaze burning bright. "Senior Sister — am I truly a demon seed?"

"Didn't I already tell you? Yes. One hundred percent, ten thousand percent — you are the one and only demon seed in all of heaven and earth, a uniquely unmatched demon lord. If you cultivate the demonic path, results will come twice as fast."

"Then why didn't Senior Sister just let me cultivate the demonic path from the start — I could have killed all of these people."

"...Junior Brother, have you considered — the reason Senior Sister did not teach it is because Senior Sister does not know it?"

"..."

"Come, run with me first."

And at that moment, in the Dream Illusion realm, Ye Wanwan and Shen Nanzhou sat cross-legged facing each other. Xingze and the dream spirit stood guard. Around Ye Wanwan, the five golden cores floated in a formation, creating a protective boundary around her physical body.

But—

"Three days and they still have not woken up!" Xingze was frantic.

The dream spirit's expression was strange. "I get the feeling that young man is in quite a good mood."

As it said this, it scanned the dream silk tangled around Shen Nanzhou. The threads had already begun to loosen — as he started to break free of the nightmare of the massacre, the dream silk was gradually unknotting.

But—

A larger blue rope had appeared.

Xingze stared blankly. "What is this?"

The dream spirit looked complicated. "He has developed a new obsession."

The small loose threads were unravelling, yes. But this one—

Was even thicker than before.

Xingze asked, "Can they still wake up?"

The dream spirit's eyes rolled around. "Hard to say. The longer someone spends inside the dream realm, the more their memories of the outside world blur. Eventually they forget entirely that they are people from outside, and become dream-dwellers permanently."

Xingze's expression changed. "Why did you not say this before?"

The dream spirit showed its teeth. "Why would I say it?"

"Once they cannot get out, they will sleep forever, and become my nourishment! Ha ha ha!" The dream spirit laughed loudly. In the middle of that laugh, Xingze saw it gradually breaking free of the Soul-Locking Incantation.

It was breaking out of the cage.

And it had been working on this the whole time — and had finally found the opportunity while Ye Wanwan was deep in the dream!

It had been deliberate!

Xingze suddenly understood everything!

The one keeping Ye Wanwan trapped was not Shen Nanzhou — it was this thing!

Xingze immediately retreated, dodging the dream spirit. But blue silk threads came flying out and wrapped around the small stone. The dream spirit said in a creeping voice, "Little creature — actually, you smell quite delicious too."

Xingze screamed, "Master!"

"Help! Help!"

"Master!"

The dream spirit gave a cold laugh. "Give up. I told you — once they go in, they cannot come out. Inside this dream realm, only I am the master. Every cultivator here will become my nourishment!"

"Become my power!"

"Ha ha ha!"

In the midst of that laughter, the dream spirit fully broke through the Soul-Locking Incantation. The incantation shattered. Ye Wanwan's physical body seemed to flicker — but the dream spirit was already lunging toward her in that same instant.

It had to kill her first!

The threat she posed was too great!

But the golden cores spun and deflected its attack, shielding Ye Wanwan.

The dream spirit's eyes went deep. "Damned things — I will break through them one by one!"

Drawing on the spiritual energy it had pulled from the dream silk, it slammed ferociously at Ye Wanwan's defensive boundary. The five golden cores blazed in response, holding their ground — and at the same moment, a quiet murmur came from behind it.

"What is this? Thinking of causing trouble?"

The dream spirit's body went rigid. It spun its head around so hard its neck nearly twisted off, and saw Ye Wanwan standing behind it.

And alongside her — Shen Nanzhou.

Two Ye Wanwans. Two Shen Nanzhouss.

The dream spirit stumbled back a step in fright. "You... no, no, this is not right. You are inside my dream realm. Is there anything to be afraid of? I am the master of this dream realm..."

The dream spirit quickly regained its confidence.

Ye Wanwan pointed toward the golden core boundary ahead of them. Her voice carried a cruelty that broke the dream spirit's heart. "Who told you we are in your dream realm?"

Dream spirit: "?"

Ye Wanwan murmured under her breath, "A dream rises and falls across half a lifetime. Origins come and go across ten thousand realms."

"Break."

Word by word as she spoke, the Ye Wanwan and Shen Nanzhou who had been sitting cross-legged behind the dream spirit shattered like a broken mirror. The dark mist broke open.

They had returned together to inside the cave dwelling.

Ye Wanwan crooked a finger, and Xingze came flying back from the stone to Ye Wanwan's side. Beside it was half of an unburned dream talisman. Person and spirit smiled — warmly.

Ye Wanwan said with soft gentleness, "You are not the only one who can make dreams, friend."

Dream spirit: WHAT!

A worthy opponent!!

chapters.title: Will You Come Back?
chapters.content:
The dream spirit turned and fled.

But talisman golden light came closing in from every direction. The smashed lantern reassembled itself.

The dream spirit accelerated, trying to break through.

But five golden cores locked down the five cardinal directions, firmly anchoring the Soul-Locking Incantation — keeping pace and accelerating with it, allowing the dream spirit nowhere to escape, trapping it with perfect precision.

The dream spirit could not comprehend how Ye Wanwan had done it.

"How could you possibly have constructed a dream right under my eyes?"

A dream within a dream!

The dream spirit could have cracked its skull trying to figure out when Ye Wanwan had started laying the groundwork. It had all been seamless — not a single flaw visible. The spirit was nearly losing its mind. "When did you first suspect me?"

Ye Wanwan said flatly, "From the moment you made contact with me, I suspected you."

Dream spirit: "...?"

Ye Wanwan said flatly, "As a dream spirit, you could not control Shen Nanzhou's dream, and could not untangle the dream silk wrapped around him. So what use were you?"

...You could have just said so — did you have to wound the spirit while you were at it?

The dream spirit was furious.

"If what you claimed was true — that you could not control Shen Nanzhou's dream and could not sort through the dream silk — you would have been genuinely terrified of him and should have found somewhere to hide. Instead you guided me into Shen Nanzhou's dream over and over, repeating it. If you were truly that afraid of his presence, why would you deliberately bring me into the dream and then tell me I could not leave unless I broke out of his dream?"

Ye Wanwan gave a quiet laugh. "Your purpose was far too obvious."

"Obvious enough that I almost felt bad pointing it out."

The dream spirit's expression twisted. "Then why did you still go along with me..."

"Of course I had to go along with you — how else would I find out what game you were playing? Those dream silk threads tangled around Shen Nanzhou — you were responsible for that. The broken memories you showed me — you wanted to deliberately lure me in. You were clever enough. You found my existence in the broken memories inside Shen Nanzhou's dream. And then you wanted to use me to deal with him, didn't you?"

The dream spirit was genuinely startled, and began to squirm. "That was... I mean... you see..."

Ye Wanwan said calmly, "Don't worry. He is asleep — he cannot hear our conversation. So for now, he will not kill you."

The dream spirit's dream, added to Ye Wanwan's own, would keep Shen Nanzhou asleep for a brief while.

Just as the dream spirit was about to exhale in relief, Ye Wanwan's tone shifted, cold as frost. "But I will."

Dream spirit: "..."

"Where is the dream silk for Senior Sister and the others? Undo it." Ye Wanwan said coldly.

"I don't know."

"Mm."

The Soul-Locking Incantation tightened sharply, then rapidly shrank to the size of a lantern — and kept shrinking. In moments it was growing tighter still. The dream spirit screamed, "Don't kill me — I'll talk! I'll tell you everything!"

"It was that young man who barged into the dream lake and disrupted everything, tangling the dream silk — I just trapped him in the dream because of it! I was only going to keep him there for a while. But then he went and blew up the realm's space, completely binding his dream with mine, and I had no choice but to find a way to break the deadlock!"

"I genuinely don't know where the dream silk for your Senior Sister and the others is."

"Everything inside is completely tangled up."

"I was looking through his memories and I happened to see you. And then you came in, and I brought you in. I had no other intentions — I was only trying to save myself!"

Ye Wanwan studied the dream spirit, weighing the truth in these words. After a long pause, she asked, "What did I look like in his memories?"

"Just like..."

Just as Ye Wanwan was listening attentively, the cave dwelling around her suddenly shuddered, like a water mirror rippling — and the disturbance only grew.

The dream spirit let out a shrill cry.

"Someone is attacking the dream realm?"

Ye Wanwan's brow furrowed as she looked.

Xingze also panicked. "There is someone attacking from outside."

"Yes."

Ye Wanwan raised her hand, about to retrieve the dream spirit.

But the Soul-Locking Incantation, as it flew past Ye Wanwan, did not stop — it drifted behind her. Ye Wanwan's expression shifted. Turning back, she saw the already-awakened Shen Nanzhou, who was holding the small ball of light and studying it with puzzlement.

"Senior Sister, is this a companion spirit?"

Ye Wanwan: "..."

How had he woken up early?

The dream spirit was also trembling. It knew it had been wrong — it should not have been so greedy. How had it managed to attract two people, one after the other, each more terrifying than the last?

Ye Wanwan held out her hand. "Give it back."

The dream spirit as a small ball of light made a pitiful sound and tried to hook onto Ye Wanwan's hand with a little extended arm — because on reflection, it had decided this young woman's side was safer.

Shen Nanzhou smiled. "Senior Sister, let me play with it a while?"

The young man's complexion was still somewhat pale, and dream silk still trailed around him — clearly he had forced himself awake. Provoking him further right now would not be wise.

Ye Wanwan took a deep breath, steadied herself, and asked, "Do you know the Clear Heart Incantation?"

Shen Nanzhou's eyes lifted slightly. He raised an eyebrow. "Why?"

"Recite it."

Ye Wanwan said coldly. "A dream is born from desire. Your senses are not clear — the Clear Heart Incantation will help you. Cultivate it now and dissolve all the dream silk."

The sounds of attack from outside were growing louder. Ye Wanwan's voice also carried a chill. "Quickly."

Shen Nanzhou knew the young woman was not wrong — he simply did not want to do it. But looking at her drawn, tense little face overlapping with a face from inside the dream, Shen Nanzhou paused, then obligingly sat down.

He even tucked the dream spirit into his sleeve. "Senior Sister, we agreed I could borrow it — don't take it back."

Ye Wanwan: "..."

Fine.

You're something else.

She turned and walked toward the cave dwelling that was about to fall apart. Xingze said, "We are not out yet."

"I know."

Shen Nanzhou's dream and the dream spirit's birthplace, the dream lake, had been bound together. The explosion of the realm's space meant they were currently unable to separate. But Ye Wanwan had already used the power of the new dream to strip away the dream silk tangled on Shen Nanzhou and the obsession that had gripped him.

Almost time.

It was just...

Ye Wanwan looked at the powerful waves ahead, her expression cool.

"There is always someone who can't wait and has to cause trouble for everyone else."

That spiritual aura — Ye Wanwan knew it well.

Ji Changhuai.

Ye Wanwan brought her hands together in a seal, and five golden cores came spinning outward. The dream spirit that had slipped out of Shen Nanzhou's sleeve and Shen Nanzhou himself both looked up at the same time, person and spirit both going momentarily blank.

"So many golden cores!"

Five golden cores locked onto the dream realm's space.

With all her golden cores deployed, Ye Wanwan's own cultivation power was nearly depleted. For safety, she turned and looked at Shen Nanzhou. She pressed a seal and retrieved the five golden cores that had been trapping the dream spirit, taking them in her hand.

Only one layer of Soul-Locking Incantation remained.

"Junior Brother — since the dream spirit has been lent to you, you had better keep a close eye on it. Don't let it run away."

She said this and walked away quickly.

Shen Nanzhou called out. "Senior Sister!"

Ye Wanwan turned, puzzled.

The young man's pale face held a slight smile. And within it — a probe. And a tightness he had not even noticed himself. His voice came out hoarse.

"Will you... come back?"

chapters.title: I Deserve Your Bows!
chapters.content:
Ye Wanwan said coldly, "Of course."

Her golden cores were still here.

She would be back to collect them regardless.

The young woman said this and walked away without hesitation.

Leaving Shen Nanzhou alone.

The dream spirit whispered insidiously, "She was insulting you. You are not angry?"

Shen Nanzhou furrowed his brow. "Are you jealous that she cares about me?"

Dream spirit: "..."

What did that have to do with anything?

Shen Nanzhou looked around at the space held by five golden cores, and said quietly, "She left half her cultivation power here."

And as he said it, he smiled.

The dream spirit was baffled. Brother, are you still inside the dream and not fully awake yet?

She clearly just trapped the two of them so they would not go out and cause trouble!

It had only changed from a small cage to a bigger one.

But seeing that Shen Nanzhou had no awareness of this at all, the dream spirit stayed quiet. The aftereffects of the new dream were significant — this person had not fully pulled free yet.

It did not know what dream that young woman had constructed for him, but the lingering effects were striking.

—

Ye Wanwan exited the dream and stepped into a dense forest.

Her feet touched soft earth and the clean smell of grass and wood reached her, giving Ye Wanwan the fleeting sensation of returning to a forest. She looked up.

The sky was bright.

No sun, but full of light.

She had truly come out.

After all, dreams had no sky.

But the mountain peak of Cloud Mountain Cave had already been levelled. The cave dwelling was gone.

Ye Wanwan considered briefly. Dream Illusion Elder had mentioned there was something precious at the end of the third path. What had it been?

Just the dream spirit?

That did not seem like much of a treasure.

Dream spirit: Are you looking down on spirits?

"Everyone focus — we can break through this together and wake them up!"

"Right!"

The call went out, followed by another enormous burst of noise.

Ye Wanwan looked up and saw ahead, in the ruins, the various coloured spiritual lights gathering into a single beam that shot toward the sky, directed squarely at a grey vortex and hammering away at it.

The vortex's scale was already quite small — only about one zhang across.

Taking the full brunt of their combined attacks, it was dissolving.

And leading the charge was Ji Changhuai.

Xingze climbed back into the stone and jumped to Ye Wanwan's shoulder. "That person does have some ability."

The point of attack was precisely the centre of the dream realm.

Ye Wanwan's eyes held a trace of self-mockery. "Yes. The senior disciple of Azure Cloud Peak, after all."

Sensing Ye Wanwan's displeasure, Xingze said nothing more.

Ye Wanwan stepped onto her sword and flew toward the group, searching among the crowd for any sign of Bai Jian and the others. When she finally spotted Bai Jian, Fang He'an, and Li Wanzhi standing outside the main group, as though they had been excluded by everyone else—

Ye Wanwan's eyes dimmed.

"Junior Sister!"

Bai Jian, Fang He'an, and Li Wanzhi's heads all snapped upward at once. Seeing Ye Wanwan, they waved with pure delight. "Junior Sister! Here! We're over here!"

Ye Wanwan landed. "Are you all right?"

"We're fine." Li Wanzhi grabbed the first word. "We didn't know what was happening earlier — it was as though we were being dragged into a battlefield, and everyone started fighting. But then just now, we all suddenly came to our senses."

Li Wanzhi grinned. "Fortunes favour the worthy — all three of us are perfectly intact."

Bai Jian and Fang He'an also nodded, then quickly asked, "And you? Are you all right? Where did you go?"

Ye Wanwan exhaled. It seemed their dream silk had been resolved.

"I was just now..."

"Shameless. You dare say you deserve credit? This was obviously Senior Brother Ji's achievement. If he had not broken through, we would be just like all of those people — helpless."

Wang Niu pointed at the more than ten people who were still unconscious, his expression dark, extending the same contempt toward Ye Wanwan.

Ye Wanwan saw their faces, blank and in a dream-like state, and knew they were the unlucky ones from the last batch.

Ji Changhuai also sensed Ye Wanwan's arrival. He looked toward her, his gaze sharp and cold, with a trace of complexity.

He both resented her for trapping him in the corridor and found something distinctly striking about this young woman.

"I spit on that!" Li Wanzhi called out loudly, literally spitting. "You say it was him — I say it was my Junior Sister! Have you no shame?"

"Everyone woke up at the same time. Everyone was thrown out here together. Everyone figured out this was the dream exit together. And now you're telling me he is our great benefactor? Which benefactor woke up at exactly the same moment as the rest of us? Still looking fresh and full of energy?"

"Whereas my Junior Sister — travel-worn, spiritual energy barely there, looking exactly like someone who has just come through a great battle. I would bet anything it was her who spent her full strength shattering the dream and pulling us out." Li Wanzhi said it with pride.

Bai Jian and Fang He'an nodded with great conviction: exactly.

Everyone: "..."

Li Wanzhi delivered a further blow. "Don't forget — the third layer seal at Cloud Mountain Cave was opened by my Junior Sister. She entered Cloud Mountain Cave before your Master Ji. My Junior Sister is the best!"

Bai Jian and Fang He'an nodded again: exactly!

Even with Ye Wanwan's steady temperament, she gave a quiet cough. But when she caught the bright, eager eyes of those two looking at her, the modest words died on her tongue and came out instead as: "Yes. It was me."

The crowd erupted.

They had lost their minds.

"I have truly seen everything today — seen shameless before, never seen shameless like this."

"Claiming every credit that exists — then come on, break open the dream realm! You say it was you — come forward! Let's see it!"

"I want to watch how a single Qi Refining cultivator manages it. Don't get yourself killed by the backlash."

"Hold on — how is a Qi Refining cultivator even here? I thought the minimum cultivation required to enter the Dream Illusion realm was Foundation Establishment. How did she sneak in?"

"Back-door entry, obviously. Or she occupied some other poor disciple's spot."

"I despise people like this — taking up space and doing nothing!"

Li Wanzhi shook with fury, rolled up his sleeves, and was ready to fight. Ye Wanwan put up a hand to block him and stepped to the front of their group. She said coldly, "If I open this, you all admit it was me who broke the dream realm?"

"Ha. Show us first."

Ye Wanwan glanced over at Ji Changhuai. "Just to be clear — if I open it, each of you will slap yourselves ten times, kneel and kowtow three times, and say three times: 'Grandauntie, I know I was wrong.' And then I will forgive you."

"How about it?"

The crowd drew sharp breaths. "You have some nerve."

Ye Wanwan's gaze swept over them, sharp enough to make Wang Niu's chest tighten, and he forgot entirely what he had been about to say.

Ye Wanwan: "Do you agree or not?"

"If you don't dare agree, then you will apologise to my Senior Sister and Senior Brothers." Ye Wanwan raised her eyes and passed over every face in turn. Those eyes held something compelling, and every person whose gaze met hers felt a jolt through their heart.

"Because I am the one who untangled your dream silk."

"I am your life-saving benefactor."

"I deserve your bows."

Ji Changhuai was about to speak. Ye Wanwan swept a cold look his way. "Yours too — though I had no desire to save you."

The crowd was consumed with fury.

Fang He'an: ...This Junior Sister's battle power with words is something else!

Li Wanzhi: I want to learn!

Bai Jian: My Junior Sister is incomparable!

chapters.title: This Time Is Different — She Has Backing
chapters.content:
"Do you agree or not!"

Ye Wanwan asked again.

The group was furious. Wang Niu was beyond patience. "What is there to be afraid of? If you really open it, I will kneel down and call you Grandauntie three times — not just three times, ten times! Fine!"

"Right!"

"There are so many of us — and we're afraid of one Qi Refining cultivator?"

Seeing everyone growing heated, Ji Changhuai's brow furrowed. "Everyone — calm down."

"Senior Brother Ji, no need to hold us back. Today we will make sure this arrogant young woman understands the cruelty of the world! Who does she think she is? Where was she when any of this actually needed doing?"

"Getting into Cloud Mountain Cave was only because she took a step ahead of Senior Brother Ji. Would she even qualify otherwise?"

Ye Wanwan gave a cold laugh. "I would."

She did not look at the others — she looked directly at Ji Changhuai. "Is that not right, Master Ji? The wager at Cloud Mountain Cave — did you not lose?"

This made everyone even angrier. "Arrogant brat — don't push your luck. Senior Brother Ji would never lose."

"Ji Changhuai." A cold call rang out across the forest, and everyone instinctively fell silent.

Ji Changhuai froze, staring at Ye Wanwan.

Ye Wanwan said each word distinctly. "Did. You. Lose?"

Ji Changhuai's lips moved slightly. The words that had been circling his mouth could not come out.

Had he lost?

It seemed he had...

But losing to an unremarkable young woman — what did that say about all his years of bitter cultivation?

Ji Changhuai's body trembled slightly. No. He would not lose. His teacher would not accept it either.

He was doubting himself.

Ye Wanwan saw it — and it was exactly what she wanted.

To break Ji Changhuai's Dao heart. That had been the purpose of this wager all along.

And winning against him once was Ye Wanwan's first repayment to him.

That was for seven swords. She never forgot.

"Ji Changhuai!" Ye Wanwan shouted again.

This time she quietly added a touch of primordial spirit force — no one noticed.

The others, seeing Ji Changhuai say nothing, grew anxious. "Senior Brother Ji, just say it — you won. She snuck through a loophole."

Ji Changhuai's back had begun to break out in cold sweat. He wanted very much to flee.

But the situation did not allow it.

And just then, a voice rang out that was, for him, nearly celestial.

"My Senior Brother could never lose. When it comes to formation arts, no one has ever beaten him. If someone lost, it was you." A bright, charming voice came from the side. Everyone looked, and saw Ye Qian and Dou Ming pushing through the undergrowth to emerge.

Ji Changhuai was stunned. His voice nearly broke with relief. "Junior Sister."

On closer look, his eyes were even slightly damp.

Yes — he would not lose!

Ye Qian smiled and came forward. "Senior Brother~"

But she did not look at Ye Wanwan at all.

It was Dou Ming whose unfriendly gaze fixed on Ye Wanwan. "You think you can challenge my Senior Brother? Who do you think you are? Dirty and presumptuous."

Ye Wanwan lowered her gaze and gave a quiet laugh.

Very good.

Excellent.

She wanted to kill them all.

Perhaps the killing intent on the young woman was too strong — Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi both sensed it. The coldness that came over both pairs of eyes was extreme. One reached for his belt.

One gripped his sword handle.

Both wanted to step in front of Ye Wanwan.

But Bai Jian moved first. Bai Jian walked to the young woman's side and took her hand. The heavy sword drew itself from its sheath without a sound.

Ring.

Bai Jian held it in one hand, the blade pointing at Dou Ming. "Not happy. Fight."

Dou Ming's expression shifted.

Late-stage golden core.

Ye Wanwan stared at Bai Jian's clear, unclouded eyes, briefly stunned. Bai Jian said quietly, "Who do you want to fight — tell me. Senior Sister will help."

Fang He'an also said, "Junior Sister, just say the word, Senior Brother will help you!"

Li Wanzhi bellowed, "I cannot stand people whose skill is nothing but their mouths! One opening and every blade of spirit grass within ten li would be killed by the stench!"

Dou Ming's face went dark. "Who are you calling foul-mouthed?"

Li Wanzhi sneered. "Whoever responds to it."

Ye Wanwan listened to the three of them. Her eyes curved, and she could not hold back the laughter, laughing until her brows curved too — and with them, the cold in her heart.

Seeing that Ye Wanwan had relaxed, all three finally let out a breath.

Fang He'an said quietly, "Don't be afraid. Senior Brother's got you. If they dare give you trouble, I'll poison every last one of them. And if we can't handle it, it's fine — Martial Uncle and Third Senior Uncle are outside. They will definitely back us up."

What Fang He'an left unsaid: if even they could not handle it, they would keep calling for reinforcements!

Bring the whole sect if needed — surely that would be enough!

Li Wanzhi: "Right!"

Bai Jian: "Yes!"

The four of them seemed to form their own small circle, walling out everyone else — not being excluded by others, but themselves excluding the world.

Ye Wanwan felt unlimited courage rise in her.

Different from before.

This time — she had backing.

"Since you will not concede, let real skill be the judge. The Cloud Mountain Cave wager and the current one are merged: if I open the dream realm, remember—" Ye Wanwan's gaze swept over every person present.

Including Ye Qian, whose face had changed dramatically the moment she saw her.

Ye Wanwan's voice rang out clear and decisive. "All of you — every single one — will kowtow three times to the four of us, slap yourselves ten times each, and call us Grandauntie and Uncle three times!"

Li Wanzhi added, "And Granduncle."

Ye Wanwan said, "And Granduncle."

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi nodded emphatically.

Before the others could waste more words, Ye Wanwan summoned the Heart-Questioning Sword. It trembled in the air, and at the command of her pointing finger, it flew.

"Go!"

The Heart-Questioning Sword thrust at the grey vortex.

The vortex shuddered slightly — and nothing else changed.

Wang Niu and the others had been tense for a moment, but seeing this, they burst into loud laughter. "That's all you've got?"

"I thought she was something special."

But at the depth the sword pointed toward, a blue radiance bloomed. In moments, countless streams of light danced around the sword's edge. As the sword's force grew, it released a burst of golden light.

Bang!

Countless blue lights exploded.

Scattering in every direction — they were strings of thread, drifting and moving.

Everyone changed colour. That was...

Dream silk.

Everyone's dream silk.

The crowd was shocked!

"Quickly — catch those threads! Their primordial spirits are inside — if they scatter, it is all over!"

Everyone panicked.

Even Dou Ming and Ye Qian rushed forward, trying to gather the dream silk. But no matter how they moved and grabbed, the threads simply would not come back.

There was no way to get them back into place.

Wang Niu's eyes went crimson. He charged at Ye Wanwan. "I see you're trying to get them all killed! You little wretch!"

Others were also furious.

But then.

The young woman gave them a cold sweep of her eyes, formed a seal, and said quietly, "Return!"

And everyone watched those scattered fragments — drifting like ownerless wisps — shoot back to the foreheads of Li Yun and the others.

Whoosh.

Countless threads returned to their place.

Every sleeping person in the entire secret realm opened their eyes and awoke.

That enormous gasp — and the living breath that came with it — stunned every person watching. Even Wang Niu, who had been charging at Ye Wanwan, stopped in his tracks.

He stared in disbelief.

"...They're awake."

All of them awake!

chapters.title: Those Who Harm Our Senior Sister Die!
chapters.content:
The scene went very quiet.

Like time itself had stopped.

It was Li Yun's violent coughing that brought everyone back to their senses.

Wang Niu's younger brother was right beside Li Yun. He was the first one who rushed over to check on him. "Are you all right?"

Wang Ma looked up at his brother in a daze. "What happened? I'm fine — I just had a dream."

Wang Niu's eyes went red. He slapped his brother hard on the back. "As long as you're fine."

There was joy in the crowd.

There was disbelief.

There was also awkwardness and unease.

Only Li Wanzhi stepped forward, standing up straight with his chest out and his head high.

He opened his mouth and bellowed:

"Everyone!"

When all eyes turned to him, he said:

"The time to honour the wager—"

"Has arrived!"

As though afraid people had not heard him, he deliberately drew out the last syllable, projecting from deep in his chest, his voice echoing through the entire forest.

No one could find a word to say.

But Li Wanzhi had already pulled two grand chairs from his qiankun pouch and placed them behind Ye Wanwan and Bai Jian. "Senior Sister, Junior Sister — please be seated."

Ye Wanwan and Bai Jian sat down without any hesitation.

Everyone: "..."

Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an then stood to either side, looked at the crowd, and said: "Come. Kneel."

Everyone: "..."

This scene looked, no matter how one looked at it, like a wedding ceremony.

Faces went green, then pale. The resentment was palpable.

The newly-awoken Li Yun had no idea what had happened. Seeing the atmosphere, he could tell something was off. "Is there — someone willing to tell me what is going on?"

No one was willing to speak — but then Wang Niu left his brother's side and walked in large strides toward Ye Wanwan's group. Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an watched him, both already deciding: if this big ox dared make a move—

They would finish him off.

But this two-metre-tall figure thudded down in front of Ye Wanwan, and kowtowed with a resounding crack. "I, the Ox, accept the terms of the wager in defeat! Grandauntie and Granduncle, I know I was wrong!"

Fang He'an gave a short huff.

Li Wanzhi asked with insufferable nosiness, "Where were you wrong?"

"I was wrong to have eyes and no sight."

"Wrong to not recognise Mount Tai when it stood before me."

"Wrong not to respect you..."

Seeing Wang Niu look at their robes, clearly trying to identify the sect—

Fang He'an prompted, "Tianyi Sect."

Wang Niu was quick on the uptake and said loudly, "Wrong not to respect you of Tianyi Sect. In the future when I see any of you, I will call myself the grandson!"

Crack crack crack.

Three kowtows completed.

Then — smack smack smack.

Three slaps.

When he reached the fifth, Ye Wanwan said mildly, "Since your attitude in admitting fault is good — let's cut it in half. Five slaps is enough."

Wang Niu knelt and expressed his gratitude.

And he did it with a straightforward dignity, without a single calculation behind it.

Ye Wanwan and Fang He'an had both seen it — this one was brave but not clever, but he had a decent heart.

Acceptable.

Wang Niu was done. That left the others.

Ye Wanwan and Li Wanzhi scanned through every face in the crowd — mouths going strong just a moment ago, not one of them daring to make a peep now.

Others were genuinely mortified, but with Wang Niu as the example, one by one they conceded. In no time at all, most had followed through on the wager.

Though the sound of palms meeting faces was not quite as sharp as it might have been.

Li Wanzhi had been ready to roll up his sleeves and do it himself, but Fang He'an held him back. "Let it go — don't make enemies that will trip us up later."

Li Wanzhi could only stand down — though with some regret.

"I have never tried hitting someone else's face before."

"Next time I must give it a go!"

Fang He'an: "..."

Most people were willing to honour the wager, but a small number were not.

They scoured desperately for excuses, and eventually spotted the dream realm entrance still intact above them. They announced loudly, "We agreed on breaking open the dream realm! The entrance is still there! That does not count as winning!"

"Right! It doesn't count!"

The four of Ye Wanwan's group: Hmm.

Ye Wanwan said mildly, "How dull."

Bai Jian: "Very dull."

Watching a crowd kneel for ages without knowing who anyone was.

Ye Wanwan tilted her head to look at Bai Jian, and smiled. "Since Senior Sister is bored, shall we go?"

"Yes."

The two of them rose. Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an fell immediately into step behind them. Li Wanzhi also took back the chairs — they had been taken from the inn and he was absolutely bringing them back as a filial gift for their teacher and martial uncle.

Of course he was taking them.

Why would he leave them for these people?

As the four left, Ye Wanwan and Li Wanzhi both let their eyes pass over the faces of those who had refused to concede.

The look in those eyes was entirely unmistakable — remember these faces. We will deal with this later.

The crowd felt a prickle of unease.

But seeing Ji Changhuai and his group still standing there, they felt somewhat less alarmed.

Dou Ming had been holding himself back for a long time. He had been telling himself not to stoop to their level — but when Ye Wanwan's mocking gaze swept over him, he could not take it anymore.

"Stop right there!"

Ye Wanwan and Li Wanzhi turned back simultaneously, eyes bright and burning.

Not worried in the slightest.

Both practically itching for it.

Li Wanzhi: Finally an excuse to act.

But just at that moment, the vortex above dissolved quietly, and a blue-gold stream of light came sweeping out, flying toward Ye Wanwan and landing before her. Ye Wanwan was briefly startled — but also saw the dream spirit's awkward, toothy expression, though its features were impossible to make out clearly.

The expressions of everyone else, however, changed dramatically.

"A companion spirit!"

Dou Ming and Ye Qian both went pale. "A realm spirit!"

Possessing it meant unhindered access through the entire secret realm — a once-in-an-age treasure. One could even use it to absorb the entire realm.

Even Ji Changhuai went briefly still.

But in the next instant, Dou Ming and Ye Qian both reacted simultaneously.

"Take it!"

Without a moment's hesitation, the two of them surged forward, moving before Li Yun and the others had even processed the situation.

Ye Wanwan's brow lifted. She pulled the dream spirit in first, and was already moving to summon her sword.

But the heavy brute sword swept through the air in a wide arc. Bai Jian appeared in front of Ye Wanwan in an instant. The woman gripped her sword — as tall as she was — and brought it down like a mountain, crashing toward Dou Ming!

Dou Ming tried to dodge. He could not.

The aura had locked him in place.

Bang!

Bai Jian drove him into the ground more than a zhang deep. He could not get up no matter how he tried. Then Bai Jian turned and swept her gaze toward Ye Qian as well.

But a palm came from behind Ye Qian. Ji Changhuai poured his full spiritual energy into assisting Ye Qian, bringing it to clash with Bai Jian's sword energy.

Ji Changhuai: "Use your spiritual energy."

Ye Qian immediately ran hers.

Sword energy swept outward.

Ye Qian struck with a palm!

Bang!

The massive collision of force pushed everyone back!

"Late-stage golden core — and great completion golden core!"

Two powers meeting head-on.

The ground beneath both their feet collapsed into a pit more than a zhang deep — and the already-buried Dou Ming sank even further.

But neither side separated.

Evenly matched.

"A draw!"

The crowd was stunned.

Someone called out, "What draw? She launched a surprise attack — Master Ji had to respond without preparation. Of course he would be a step slower. How can you call it a draw?"

Everyone knew this was flattery for Wushang Sect, and not a single person in the crowd echoed it. Not even Li Yun, who had always been the first to flatter Ji Changhuai.

Because everyone could see — Bai Jian was fighting alone. But Ji Changhuai and Ye Qian were two people.

One against two. Still a draw.

This woman... what remarkable physical constitution and talent.

"But she's about to lose anyway."

They looked — and indeed, Ji Changhuai's cultivation level exceeded Bai Jian's, and with Ye Qian added in, Bai Jian had already begun to fall back. One step...

Two steps.

But just as Bai Jian took her third step back, two figures silently closed in — one from above the dream realm, one from directly behind Bai Jian — converging on Ji Changhuai.

Ji Changhuai felt a terrifying killing intent.

Something was wrong.

The mortal danger made him react without a moment's hesitation — he withdrew his palm and pulled Ye Qian back swiftly. Where the two of them had just been standing, two figures appeared.

One was Ye Wanwan.

One was Shen Nanzhou.

Both pairs of eyes blazed with the same killing intent.

"Those who harm our Senior Sister—"

"Die."

chapters.title: Always One More Than Her
chapters.content:
Ji Changhuai dodged the lethal strike on instinct alone — but when he saw clearly who the two people were that had made the move, his expression darkened.

Her again.

Ye Qian, pulled back with him, caught a glimpse of Ye Wanwan and her expression shifted briefly. But she had always been good at concealing her feelings. What she was more concerned about was Ji Changhuai's reaction.

And when she noticed the look in Ji Changhuai's eyes as he regarded Ye Wanwan, Ye Qian's heart gave a jolt.

"Haven't you noticed?"

"She's not junior sister."

Ji Changhuai seemed to know what Ye Qian was thinking.

He said it abruptly.

That instinctive "junior sister" made Ye Qian uncomfortable.

Ji Changhuai said through clenched teeth, full of hatred: "Junior sister would never be this cold and ruthless, this brutal."

Only the eyes were alike. The personalities were worlds apart.

She had nearly destroyed his Dao heart.

This woman was contemptible!

"Senior brother, but she looks so much like Senior Sister. Should we show some mercy...... perhaps they have some connection." Ye Qian bit her lower lip, her brow furrowed with what appeared to be genuine reluctance.

Ji Changhuai gave a cold laugh. "They're not the same person. Why show mercy? Since they want our lives, we don't need to spare them."

Ye Qian: "Understood."

Indeed.

No matter who the person was, a dead woman was the cleanest solution.

Better than letting that person truly return and threaten her current standing in the sect.

After what happened at Xuanbing Cliff, Master had not come to see her for a long time.

And her cultivation level was still unstable.

Ye Qian didn't want any more accidents.

As she spoke, Ye Qian also gathered her energy for a lethal strike, preparing for battle.

Ye Wanwan matched her without hesitation. The two charged toward each other.

A clash — a contest of physical technique.

Ye Wanwan had already heard their conversation, but at this point, nothing either of them said could stir even the slightest ripple in her.

Because it had nothing to do with her anymore.

If it were the past, she might actually have been hurt.

Now?

Good riddance.

The situation shifted too quickly.

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi came back to their senses and rushed forward immediately. They checked on Bai Jian first, saw she was unharmed, then looked with anxious worry toward Ye Wanwan.

Li Wanzhi muttered a curse under his breath. "Despicable people."

Saying this sort of thing right in front of them — who knew how they had mistreated her before!

All three of them looked at Ji Changhuai with undisguised fury.

Ye Wanwan exchanged two moves with Ye Qian and was forced back two steps.

Someone in the crowd couldn't understand it. "She's qi refinement stage fighting against golden core — she's out of her mind."

Mist and water gathered out of thin air, coming together in Ye Wanwan's palm. It looked like a soft, yielding cloud — or a warm, drifting fog. But who could know the destructive force contained within?

Bai Jian was already stepping forward. "I'll go."

But Ye Wanwan and Shen Nanzhu spoke at the same time: "Senior sister, no need."

Bai Jian: "......"

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi: "......"

When did those two develop this kind of unspoken understanding?

Ji Changhuai gave a cold laugh. "You really want to fight, do you?"

Ye Wanwan laughed softly. "Afraid of you?"

Her words fell, and the girl struck out — with a whoosh, a sky full of water mist rolled toward Ji Changhuai and Ye Qian. To be precise: toward their eyes.

A column of water was undeniably powerful in attack. But thinner mist was far more penetrating, finding every opening.

So Ye Wanwan wasn't using a column — she was using mist!

Ji Changhuai's smile was cold. He wasn't afraid.

Because his junior sister Ye Qian also had a water spirit root — and a peak-grade one at that!

Ye Qian immediately launched a counter-mist, intending to humiliate Ye Wanwan with the same technique. But no one had expected what happened next — when the two forces collided, Ye Wanwan's was the stronger!

The crowd erupted.

"She's not qi refinement stage!"

Ye Wanwan laughed quietly. "When did I ever say I was?"

The spiritual energy around the girl released in a burst, breaking through qi refinement in an instant and rising rapidly to foundation establishment.

Then into golden core!

"Golden core early stage!"

Li Yun and the others were completely stunned.

Everyone's mind was racing with questions.

How had she hidden her cultivation — with a magic treasure? But what sect would be extravagant enough to give their disciple a high-level artifact that concealed spiritual energy?

Was Tianyi Sect really that wealthy?!

Ye Qian bit down on her lip too. If she wasn't qi refinement stage, then blocking her attack was understandable — but why could she beat her? This golden core was hers — Ye Wanwan's core!

Heaven-grade!

A full tier above peak-grade!

Why was she still losing?

Ye Qian lost the first exchange, but immediately seized the opening to strike back at Ye Wanwan. She stopped using water mist and instead summoned her magic treasure — the Illusory Water Divine String.

She drew the bow swiftly and condensed arrows, shooting them toward Ye Wanwan in rapid succession.

At the same time, with her left hand she drew out a protective water ring, pulling distance between herself and Ye Wanwan.

The crowd cheered.

"Worthy of Qingyun Peak's greatest genius. Drawing arrows with one hand and drawing a ring with the other — right hand attacking, left hand defending. That kind of divided focus — only someone truly exceptional could do it."

Cultivators with water spirit roots in the audience went quiet. That was an understatement.

Just the arrow condensation alone — none of them could match Ye Qian's level.

Three arrows in one breath.

And with ease.

Three water arrows broke through the air. Ye Wanwan evaded them without hurry. Listening to the murmuring crowd and watching the satisfaction rising in Ye Qian's eyes, Ye Wanwan gave a quiet laugh. "Is that all? As if no one else could do that."

She raised her palm, and a spiritual bow made entirely of pure water element appeared in her hand. Everyone could see it now — she was going to return the exact same technique!

"Good heavens, are they really doing this?"

"Ye Qian is golden core mid-stage. She's only early stage and she dares to do this — is she genuinely confident or just arrogant?"

No one knew.

But as Ye Wanwan drew her spiritual bow, three arrows condensed on the string at once.

"Wait — that's wrong!"

"That's four!"

She released, then drew again. And this time, everyone saw — a fifth arrow!

The crowd went silent.

Jaws dropped.

Then the noise exploded.

"What on earth!"

Every cultivator with a water spirit root had lost their mind. "How is she getting five water arrows from a bow she formed purely from spiritual energy? Who is she?!"

"Someone tell me — who is she?!"

Others couldn't see the subtlety, but the water-element cultivators could see it with absolute clarity.

Ye Qian could fire three arrows because of the Illusory Water Divine String.

Because everyone knew — it was a peak-grade spirit treasure that the Dao Venerable Yanding had personally obtained from the extreme southern water territory for his young disciple, forged from the divine water string. Its power ranked just beneath a divine artifact.

But if Ye Wanwan's improvised bow was producing the same result — what did that make the Illusory Water Divine String?

Of course it wasn't that the string was poor quality.

That left only one explanation.

Ye Qian had failed to bring out this treasure's true capabilities!

Ye Qian's eyes reddened. She struck back furiously. The two of them kept firing arrows, each one colliding with the other mid-air, detonating in bursts of water element.

But Ye Wanwan always had one more arrow than Ye Qian. Every single extra one landed on her water ring.

Without exception.

At first no one understood why. But those paying close attention eventually noticed — Ye Wanwan's arrows always landed in the same spot.

And as the fifth arrow flew, Ye Wanwan said calmly: "You've lost."

Others still didn't understand what was happening, but Ji Changhuai, Bai Jian, and Fang He'an had all seen it.

Ye Qian's water ring — was broken.

Her defense could no longer hold.

"I haven't lost!"

Ye Qian screamed and condensed seven arrows at once, firing them in a frantic barrage at Ye Wanwan. But Ye Wanwan raised her bow with complete calm, and without any visible effort, condensed eight arrows.

Always — always one more than Ye Qian.

chapters.title: The Greatest Genius
chapters.content:
"The greatest genius of Qingyun Peak in the Supreme Sect — remember this name. Your goal is to surpass her!"

"Surpass her!"

"If you cannot do it, you are no daughter of mine!"

Ye Congyue's stern voice echoed over and over in Ye Qian's ears. Word by word, since childhood, since she had first learned to read — she had known only one name, only one goal.

To become a genius.

And to surpass Ye Wanwan.

Everyone knew that Qingyun Peak of the Supreme Sect had a supreme genius who had entered the qi refinement stage at eight. Within just two years of taking a master, she had stunned countless cultivators, becoming the youngest cultivator to reach the qi refinement stage.

So many people had wanted to see her in person.

But Qingyun Peak had protected her extremely well. Whether it was the peak master or her senior brothers, every mention of this youngest junior sister was overflowing with pride and admiration.

When eight-year-old Ye Qian had visited the Supreme Sect, every time anyone mentioned Qingyun Peak's youngest junior sister, their eyes and voices were full of pride.

"That's our little junior sister! You don't know her? She's so wonderful — brilliant and well-mannered and incredibly thoughtful and kind. Not a shred of arrogance despite being such a genius!"

"Right, right — last time the sect master rewarded her with a qi-nourishing pill, and she gave it away without a second thought to a senior brother who had been injured. And they weren't even close — she only stopped because when she was returning to the mountain, she saw him kneeling alone at the foot of the hill, and when she asked what happened, she learned he had been seriously injured by a wild beast, failed his mission, and was being punished by his master."

"So she went and pleaded for him, and gave him the pill to help him recover."

"How could anyone have such a wonderful little junior sister."

Those words of praise entered her ears.

And in that moment, Ye Qian understood what her father meant when he said she had to surpass this person.

She also wanted to become that genius everyone spoke of.

She also wanted to be the junior sister that everyone praised.

So she worked toward it, step by step, and schemed toward it, step by step. She finally managed to enter Qingyun Peak as well, to stand beside this girl and call her "senior sister," closing the distance between them bit by bit.

And this girl was exactly as everyone had described — open and unguarded toward her, a pure and wholehearted kindness.

Which was precisely why, gradually, she had discovered the secret that tormented this genius.

After breaking through to the golden core stage, Ye Wanwan's cultivation had stagnated.

This was her chance.

She could surpass her now!

But Ye Qian had never anticipated that her own core formation would fail. And in her most desperate moment, her gaze had turned to Ye Wanwan. Through a single arranged match, she had used strategy to take Ye Wanwan's golden core.

Yet.

Ye Qian would never forget the day Ye Wanwan's core was torn out. Looking at her, Ye Wanwan had said: "You will never beat me."

"Never."

Just one step short.

Always just one step short.

The extra arrow now — it was just like the look Ye Wanwan had given her that day. Calm, composed, without any trace of hatred. She seemed to feel almost nothing about having her golden core taken.

Ye Qian had assumed the matter would simply pass. She had never imagined that two days later, the news would come that Ye Wanwan had destroyed her own cultivation.

She couldn't understand her.

Just as she couldn't understand the girl in front of her now.

Why — why did she have to humiliate her like this?!

Ye Qian's eyes slowly flooded red. Past all reason, she condensed her arrows again — this time shattering her own record, matching Ye Wanwan at the eighth arrow.

But everyone could see she was forcing herself.

Her body was trembling.

Blood began to drip from her nose.

Ji Changhuai froze.

Dou Ming, who had just crawled out of the pit, went red-eyed. "Senior brother, stop her! Junior sister, she——"

Her golden core was unstable!

Her cultivation level hadn't fully stabilized yet!

The damage from her last seclusion hadn't fully healed!

If she couldn't bring out the Illusory Water Divine String's true power, and kept pushing like this, something terrible was going to happen.

Ji Changhuai jolted at Dou Ming's warning. He lunged to stop Ye Qian — but his method of stopping her was to turn on Ye Wanwan.

Only by making this person stop would junior sister come back to her senses.

Because everyone could see it — Ye Wanwan was condensing a ninth arrow.

She had no bottleneck!

Not even a ceiling!

A talent this terrifying — he had never encountered it before. No, wait. Ji Changhuai had seen it once. His old junior sister.

Ji Changhuai's mind flashed an image — that girl in white, always sitting on Qingyun Peak, turning to look back at him with a smile: "Senior brother, I'm in the middle of sensing things."

Ji Changhuai's eyes stung. But his hands moved without slowing.

From Ji Changhuai's strike to its arrival — it seemed long, but was only an instant.

After all, this person was golden core peak. When Bai Jian moved to intercept with her sword, Dou Ming with uncanny foresight blocked her first. In that split second, Ji Changhuai's palm had already driven toward Ye Wanwan.

And shattered her spiritual bow.

The girl's expression was indifferent, as if this didn't shock her, as if she hadn't gone pale.

As if she had been waiting for this moment.

Ji Changhuai felt something ominous. This girl was too calm — too calm. Was it a trap?

But just then, a hand reached out from the side, pulling the girl away. Palm meeting palm, catching Ji Changhuai's lethal strike.

Boom!

The enormous spiritual energy collision sent both sides flying.

Ji Changhuai was pushed back seven or eight steps. The other was thrown back dozens of meters.

Being prepared was always different from being caught off-guard.

Not to mention the difference in cultivation level.

Shen Nanzhu, carrying Ye Wanwan, crashed into the forest, smashing through three or four trees. And even as he crashed into the trunks, he had pulled Ye Wanwan in front of him.

Using his back to shield her.

Ye Wanwan blinked.

Xingtse and Mengling, who had been ready to strike from within her sleeve: "......"

You're not giving us any chance to shine!

"Junior sister!"

Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an charged into the forest at full speed.

Bai Jian was beside herself with urgency.

All three rushed into the forest and found Shen Nanzhu and Ye Wanwan. Seeing Shen Nanzhu push himself upright and spit out a mouthful of blood, Fang He'an was nearly driven to rage.

Li Wanzhi's eyes went red. "These bastards! These bastards!"

Then he slapped himself hard in the face.

"When I get back I'm going to train until I drop. No more slacking!"

Tears were running down his face as he spoke.

Fang He'an rummaged frantically through his medicine pouches, barely finding a usable vial. "Eat it, quick — junior sister too. This one's not poisoned."

Ye Wanwan and Shen Nanzhu were force-fed the pills. By the time they came back to their senses, Bai Jian had already taken up her sword and was walking step by step toward Ji Changhuai. Spiritual energy coiled around the young woman — pure and clean as light.

She lifted her eyes toward Ji Changhuai.

And drove a sword strike out with everything she had!

"Get out!"

The sword energy swept across the sky, nearly tearing it open. The ferocious blade slashed toward Ji Changhuai — and under this single strike, Ji Changhuai, a golden core peak cultivator——

Was driven feet-first into the ground.

He coughed up a mouthful of blood.

And the sword energy still hadn't dispersed!

Ye Wanwan and Shen Nanzhu took one look at this and knew it was bad.

So did everyone else.

"Vast Sky Strike!"

This was already a technique beyond the golden core stage — it belonged to the nascent soul realm!

Crack.

Something far overhead seemed to split open.

The secret realm could not bear Bai Jian's sword!

chapters.title: Mutated Wood Spirit Root
chapters.content:
The Illusory Dream Secret Realm had already become unstable from the collapse of two companion spirit spaces. One had been blown up by Ye Wanwan, and one by Shen Nanzhu.

And now.

Bai Jian's sword had directly torn through the last thing holding it together.

Everyone heard the sound. Everyone saw the cracks in the sky growing wider, as if darkness were descending — the light vanished, bit by bit, darker and darker.

Only the sword light remained blazing!

Not a trace of retreat in Bai Jian's eyes. She had only one thought — anyone who bullied junior sister deserved to be hit!

Beaten into the ground!

The resolve in Bai Jian's eyes only grew stronger.

And then, impossibly, the sword energy kept layering!

Everyone stared in disbelief.

With a thud, Ji Changhuai finally couldn't hold on any longer.

He coughed up blood.

Bai Jian's erupting sword energy was too overwhelming. In this moment, it was as if the person at golden core peak was not him, but Bai Jian — and the power of this single strike had already exceeded the golden core level.

It carried nascent soul force!

Boom!

Ji Changhuai could no longer hold his ground. The sword energy erupted and drove him into the earth below. Dou Ming and Ye Qian went white with shock, both crying out: "Senior brother!"

Dou Ming roared: "Earth force — shield!"

The ground trembled. Spiritual energy surged around Ji Changhuai, erecting a powerful defense. Dou Ming threw himself forward without hesitation and shielded Ji Changhuai's body.

Ye Qian snapped out of her obsessive stubbornness and drew her bow, aiming at Bai Jian.

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!

Seven arrows released.

Li Wanzhi picked up a rock. "Oh for the love of——"

He channeled spiritual energy into the stone and hurled it with precise force at the arrows. He shattered three. Fang He'an saw and charged in too — and as he moved, trees began to grow from the ground around him.

"Down!"

Countless trees erupted from the earth, rising as a wall of wood before Bai Jian. These trees were covered in sharp spines coated in purple liquid.

The moment they appeared, the surrounding plant life withered dramatically. Even the water arrows flying toward Bai Jian were completely corroded before they arrived.

The crowd collectively drew a sharp breath.

"Wood spirit root."

"It's mutated wood element!"

"Poison——"

"Oh no."

Nobody had expected it. The gentle, clean-looking Fang He'an's technique was this unusual. The trees his cultivation summoned looked like grotesque tree demons — wrapped in pale purple poisonous cloth, covered in thorns.

Gnashing and snarling.

The contrast with his actual demeanor was violent.

Fang He'an stood guard in front of Li Wanzhi and Bai Jian. His expression was cold. He didn't like using his technique in front of others — but just because he didn't use it didn't mean he was a pushover.

Of course, the reason he rarely used it was because the range was too wide and he couldn't fully control it.

But right now — who cared!

Ye Wanwan had already gotten to her feet. She looked at Shen Nanzhu, her expression deeply complicated. "Why did you jump out?"

She had a way to make Ji Changhuai suffer.

Shen Nanzhu was still sitting. He looked up at Ye Wanwan and said with a quiet laugh: "Because I felt sorry for Senior Sister."

Ye Wanwan: "......"

Her expression grew even more complicated. "Junior brother, do you really have to do this?"

That wasn't the kind of relationship they had.

Hearing it only made her think he was being sarcastic.

Shen Nanzhu watched Ye Wanwan's expression, saw she didn't seem to be joking, and the smile on his face slowly faded. The depth in his eyes shifted briefly. He turned his head to the side and said quietly: "I thought I was still in the dream."

Ye Wanwan understood then.

The after-effects of the dreamscape were clearly still hitting hard.

She held out her hand.

Shen Nanzhu frowned. "What for?"

"Get up," Ye Wanwan said flatly. "You can't just sit there forever. Senior sister is venting our anger for us."

Shen Nanzhu looked at Ye Wanwan's hand for a moment, then pushed himself up using the tree instead.

Ye Wanwan saw this, withdrew her hand, and walked on.

Shen Nanzhu had just cleaned off and extended his own hand — and caught nothing. "......"

Truly merciless.

Ji Changhuai had been critically injured by that single strike. Bai Jian, having erupted with such powerful sword energy, was depleted. The two of them had dealt each other heavy blows — but Ji Changhuai's injuries were significantly worse.

The sky was already half dark. The entire secret realm — half night, half day.

The place where they stood was a broken darkness.

Dark enough that you couldn't see your hand in front of your face.

Ye Wanwan quickly reached Bai Jian's side and channeled spiritual energy into her. "Senior sister, are you all right?"

Bai Jian nodded. "I'm fine. I just didn't eat enough. I'm hungry."

Even though she had brought plenty of rations when she came in, staying for a month meant she had been rationing carefully — never eating her fill.

Ye Wanwan heard this and laughed, her voice gentle. "We'll find somewhere to eat soon. I brought a lot of food too."

Bai Jian smiled and nodded emphatically. "Good!"

"Everyone run! This part of the secret realm is collapsing!"

Bai Jian's sword had torn half the space open. The darkness spreading from above was still expanding. Li Yun and Wang Niu took one look and turned and bolted without another word.

In an instant, everyone was acting out of self-preservation.

Everyone fled.

Ye Wanwan moved to carry Bai Jian on her back. Bai Jian shook her head. "Junior sister, Senior sister is fine. I can walk on my own."

Ye Wanwan didn't give her the chance to refuse.

Carried her up.

Li Wanzhi said: "I'll fly on my sword."

Fang He'an said: "Can't use the sword. The space above is unstable — sword flight would get us pulled into the current. We have to run on foot."

Ye Wanwan heard this and moved her hand, drawing four speed talismans. Four flashes of light attached to the feet of all four of them — including Shen Nanzhu.

Ye Wanwan said: "Move!"

All four felt their steps grow effortlessly light. Li Wanzhi took one stride and covered dozens of paces.

Li Wanzhi was stunned.

"This is faster than the Swiftwind Technique!"

Ye Wanwan carried Bai Jian and caught up. "It only lasts one incense stick's worth of time."

"Stay with me."

Ye Wanwan said it and moved ahead. She didn't glance back at Ji Changhuai. Didn't look at Ye Qian either.

Li Wanzhi was furious. "We shouldn't have let them off."

Fang He'an understood priorities. "I'm not afraid of fighting — but a real fight takes too much time. If the secret realm collapses with us inside, none of us escape. Those people aren't worth us paying that price."

He paused, then added: "Don't be angry — I did leave something for them."

Li Wanzhi's eyes lit up. "What?"

"Something good."

Fang He'an smiled.

Li Wanzhi knew exactly what that meant.

Poison.

Shen Nanzhu heard this and looked at Fang He'an for a long moment, a deep red flickering briefly in his eyes.

Fang He'an seemed to sense it and looked back. "Junior brother, senior brother will remember to get you your revenge."

Shen Nanzhu pressed his lips together. Then he suddenly picked up his pace, moving past both of them, and said, walking on: "Focus on keeping yourself alive first."

Fang He'an scratched his head. "Why is he suddenly annoyed?"

Li Wanzhi rolled his eyes. He had been about to say something critical about Shen Nanzhu, but thinking about the palm he had taken to protect junior sister, he decided to drop it. Fine. He probably just had a bad temper.

But he wasn't a bad person.

As long as he protected junior sister, he was good people.

Back in the forest they had just left.

The poison spreading from Fang He'an's toxic tree wall had seeped into the earth, creeping slowly up from the tree line toward Dou Ming's soil barrier.

Dou Ming felt his own spiritual energy being corroded. His face went white — but he still pushed through it, digging Ji Changhuai out of the pit.

Ye Qian came running over in tears. "Senior brother. Third senior brother......"

Looking at the two of them, Ye Qian's tears fell harder than ever.

She had never seen them this badly injured.

Never.

chapters.title: Tianyi Sect Is Not to Be Trifled With
chapters.content:
Ji Changhuai was barely clinging to life. Though he still had a breath in him, the spiritual energy in his body was dissipating.

Ye Qian recognized this immediately.

He was losing his cultivation!

His foundation had been damaged.

Ye Qian almost broke into sobs. Ji Changhuai was already at golden core peak. If not for coming to accompany her in search of the core-condensing fruit, he would have been in seclusion on Qingyun Peak right now, about to break through to the nascent soul stage.

He had come because she wanted to go out.

And now......

What to do.

Ye Qian's crying turned ragged.

She looked at Dou Ming, his body also covered in injuries. The normally rock-solid earth spiritual energy within him had grown unstable — even the soil wall he had erected against the poison mist was starting to crumble.

Watching the poison mist about to close in, Ye Qian wept while struggling to pull both men upright. She summoned her flying artifact, hauling the two of them onto it.

Not daring to fly high, only skimming low.

But even so, the normally reliable flying artifact jolted and lurched — a sign that the elemental forces in the space were unstable.

Yet Ye Qian didn't dare stop.

The entire forest had been contaminated by that wall of poison trees.

Anything that touched it would be assimilated, becoming a new source of deadly toxin — corroding them relentlessly, even spiritual energy couldn't hold it off.

They had never seen a poison this powerful.

Never.

Yet the person who had used it — Fang He'an — was already gone.

Ye Qian wiped her tears and looked back at Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming lying on the flying artifact, her heart filled with fear. "What do we do? What do we do?"

Dou Ming saw the fear in Ye Qian's face.

He said hoarsely: "Junior sister. Crush the transmission jade. Call for help."

Ye Qian cried: "Master is going to be furious."

Dou Ming shook his head. Voice rough: "Master won't abandon us. If we want to live, we have to call for people."

"But when we left, master was in seclusion. What if he doesn't see the message?" Ye Qian's tears were coming faster than ever.

"The sect's other elders will come," Dou Ming said. Then he seemed to lose strength. He murmured: "I won't let those people off. I won't."

"I'm going to make all of them pay......"

Watching Dou Ming seem to slip toward unconsciousness, Ye Qian was silent for a long time.

She didn't want to alert so many people. She couldn't say her private reasoning aloud — she simply didn't want Yanding to see that girl whose eyes looked so like Ye Wanwan's.

But looking at Dou Ming and Ji Changhuai, Ye Qian weighed it for a long time, and finally crushed the jade.

Without calling for help, they might not survive to leave this place.

As for that woman......

Ye Qian bit her teeth together. All of this was her fault!

All of it!

One incense stick's time later.

Ye Wanwan's pace slowed, and so did Li Wanzhi and the others. But by now they were already far beyond the range of the Cloud Mountain Cave.

The group stopped. Looking back, they felt only that the landscape behind them was a boundless, impenetrable black.

Like a deep sea into which you could throw anything and never hear it land.

And yet somehow it felt as if something inside was watching them.

It made everyone feel a deep, unsettling dread.

Li Wanzhi quietly sidled behind Fang He'an. A little cowardly.
