Fang He'an's mouth twitched. "If you practiced more when I told you to, you wouldn't be scared right now."

But as he said it, he had also drifted, without drawing attention to it, closer to Ye Wanwan — taking up position behind Senior Sister Bai Jian as well, finding a safe spot. He gave a light cough. "Junior sister, where are we going now?"

Ye Wanwan had already unrolled the map. "To the exit."

"Leaving directly?"

Too early for that.

"Not going straight there. The situation inside the secret realm will have been sensed by Xuanming Sect. They'll likely open the exit to investigate — but I'm betting they won't open it immediately. So instead of going directly, let's take a roundabout route." Ye Wanwan spread the map and drew a path. "If we see anything worth taking along the way, we take it."

Everyone looked at the map. Ye Wanwan had already circled two key points along the route.

The group understood at once.

They had to escape.

But they also had to take what was theirs.

It was a rare opportunity to be out here. No way they were going back empty-handed.

Nobody objected to Ye Wanwan's suggestion. They'd come all this way — might as well make it count.

With everyone else in a panic fleeing for their lives, they would slip around and pick up what remained.

Perfect timing!

Fang He'an thought the longer he considered it, the smarter junior sister was!

Absolutely brilliant!

But before setting out, the first thing Ye Wanwan did was reach into her qian kun pouch and pull out all the provisions she'd brought.

"Senior sister — eat first. You need to be full."

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi immediately followed suit.

Bai Jian scratched her head. "Mine are all gone. What about all of you?"

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi said in unison: "These are all for you."

Bai Jian: "......"

Fang He'an glared at Li Wanzhi. "What are you doing? Competing with me? Preparing senior sister's provisions is my job."

He even shoved Li Wanzhi away from Bai Jian's side.

This shameless favor-currying!

Li Wanzhi looked thoroughly unimpressed: "...... I was just worried you might not have brought enough, so I brought extra. And besides — what do you ever bring besides flatbreads and steamed buns? I've got meat. Meat!"

"Dried-out meat, and it's not even fresh!"

"You want fresh meat in the storage pouch, you cook it yourself!"

Shen Nanzhu stood silently watching the three of them. Then turned and walked away.

By the time Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi finished arguing and suddenly realized someone was missing, they startled: "Where's junior brother?!"

Ye Wanwan pointed into the forest.

Shen Nanzhu was dragging a freshly killed large wild rabbit over. The young man had his dagger out, its cold edge glinting. He asked in a flat voice: "Which part does senior sister want?"

Fang He'an: "......"

Li Wanzhi: "......"

They had guarded against everything — and forgotten to guard against their junior brother!

This little sideshow chased off the unpleasantness from before.

All five of them ate and rested, then got back on their feet. Though half the secret realm had collapsed, the other half remained. The two remaining points on Ye Wanwan's route were right within the safe zone.

The five moved at maximum speed, pressed forward, and then harvested.

While everyone else was running for their lives, they had taken a detour and swept up every remaining radiant stone and the leftover spirit herbs along the way.

Ten days later.

The Dim Light Stone Gate.

All the young cultivators had gathered here, waiting for the exit to open.

When Ye Wanwan's group arrived fashionably late, a sizable crowd was already assembled. And when they came through, the atmosphere immediately went quiet.

Li Yun and Wang Niu also spotted Ye Wanwan and her group. Both of their lips moved — but they said nothing. Their expressions went awkward, and they looked away toward a different corner.

Ye Wanwan followed their line of sight and saw Ye Qian — surrounded and protected by five or six capable cultivators.

And Dou Ming sitting cross-legged, regulating his breathing.

And Ji Changhuai, whose face was so pale he was nearly bloodless.

When the three of them saw Ye Wanwan's group approaching, their gazes followed. The two sides locked eyes.

The air between them was thick with tension.

At the stone gate, the crowd held their collective breath.

"Please don't let there be another fight."

"If the place collapses again, we're all done."

"That Xuanming Sect is really something — people have already sent word out, so why aren't they opening the exit early?"

"They actually are opening it early. Normally you'd have to wait a full month, but the Dim Light Stone Gate has been showing signs of movement these past few days — they're trying to open it ahead of schedule."

"If it's already been three days of signs, let's hope it actually opens today."

At those words, the crowd silently filled in the unspoken next sentence.

If it doesn't open, the other half of the secret realm is going to collapse too!

"Look — someone's standing up."

Nearly a scream. Li Yun and Wang Niu and everyone else snapped to attention. The person who stood was Ye Qian.

Everyone thought: what is she going to do now?!

Were the people of Tianyi Sect really something you wanted to provoke?!

chapters.title: So Much Grief, Held So Long
chapters.content:
No one quite knew when exactly the idea that Tianyi Sect was not to be trifled with had taken root in people's minds — but at this moment, not a single one of them wanted to antagonize Ye Wanwan and her group.

They were powerful.

And they held grudges.

And — they were united.

An invisible current of steadiness ran between these five people, as though something bound them firmly together.

Even the young man standing furthest away — his gaze never left his four companions.

Everyone had no doubt: if anyone dared to hurt even one of them, the others would rise together.

And beat the offender until they didn't dare fight back.

This kind of solidarity drew some admiration — but if they were your opponents, it was pure dread.

Ye Qian walked step by step toward them. And then suddenly, in front of Ye Wanwan, she dropped to her knees with a thud.

The crowd erupted.

Ye Qian lifted tear-blurred eyes, her voice choking. "Please. Show mercy. Let my senior brothers go."

Ye Wanwan: ?

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi exchanged a look, and with uncanny speed, one on each side, they each hooked an arm under Ye Qian's and lifted her bodily — then moved her seven or eight steps away and set her back down kneeling, this time facing the Dim Light Stone Gate.

Ye Qian: "......"

Everyone: "......"

Having done this with complete efficiency, the two of them immediately returned to Ye Wanwan and Bai Jian's side. Li Wanzhi planted one hand on his hip, pointed at the stone gate, and declared: "What do you think you're doing? Kneeling at anyone and everyone? My junior sister is just a completely ordinary, innocent, and fragile little junior sister. She's no god, no immortal. Why are you kneeling to us? Go kneel to Xuanming Sect and ask them to hurry up and open the gate!"

Fang He'an shook his head with an expression of thorough bewilderment. "This fellow from another sect — have your eyes been failing you, looking in the wrong direction? How can you kneel before anyone you like? My junior sister doesn't take disciples. Although......"

Fang He'an looked her up and down, gave a hmm, and said: "With your qualifications, Tianyi Sect wouldn't take you either. Not quite up to standard."

"Exactly, exactly."

Someone nearby couldn't hold back. "She's not up to standard? She broke through to golden core at fifteen — that's not good enough?"

Fang He'an looked genuinely puzzled. "Breaking through to golden core at fifteen is worth bragging about?"

The crowd: "......"

Fang He'an clasped his hands behind his back. "When we entered the sect, our senior uncle said: among the entire Tianyi Sect, all one hundred and one generations of disciples, not a single one has ever broken through to golden core after the age of fifteen. Breaking through golden core within three years of joining is our Tianyi Sect's——"

Li Wanzhi stepped forward, joining in at full volume: "Tradition!"

The crowd laughed despite themselves, somewhere between exasperation and disbelief.

Ye Qian, still kneeling on the ground, had gone completely pale.

Li Wanzhi then said, with magnanimous generosity: "I'm an exception, mind you — but I only joined the sect two years ago, so I've only been training for two years when you count it out properly. But compared to this junior sister over here — oh right, how long have you been training? When did your spirit roots awaken? How many years from qi refinement to golden core breakthrough?"

Li Wanzhi's questions, one after another, sent a wave of uproar through the crowd. Everyone's attention had been redirected to the perfectly normal question of what age a cultivator should expect to break through to golden core.

As for why Ye Qian had knelt before Ye Wanwan in the first place — nobody remembered anymore.

In fact, Ye Qian herself had been kneeling there for a while now without anyone noticing she was still kneeling.

Li Wanzhi held court, answering every challenge thrown at him with complete confidence and fluency.

"I'm the youngest of my family, spoiled and good-for-nothing since birth. My spirit roots didn't awaken until I was twelve — which my father called a late bloomer and considered a great compliment. I was very pleased with myself and spent three relaxed years reaching qi refinement level three. At that point my father couldn't stand to watch anymore, and he sold — I mean buried me, made me reflect for three days and three nights, and then enrolled me in Tianyi Sect."

"Tianyi Sect truly is blessed land. Even a good-for-nothing like me——" Li Wanzhi thumped his own chest loudly, "——is now golden core!"

The crowd's faces went through several shades of color. They desperately wanted to say Li Wanzhi was exaggerating — but Li Wanzhi let his aura slip out, and it was unmistakably golden core.

Damn.

Nothing to say to that.

Through all of this — from the moment Ye Qian knelt, through Li Wanzhi and the others' entire performance — Ye Wanwan said nothing. She simply watched her two senior brothers holding the entire crowd.

Fang He'an noticed she hadn't spoken for a long while. Thinking she was worried, he said quietly: "That kind of person specializes in moral manipulation. Don't be afraid. Senior brother has this."

Li Wanzhi heard this too, and lowered his voice with a cold laugh. "Ha. There are so many people here, including cultivators from sects specializing in healing. She could have knelt to anyone — but she came and knelt in front of junior sister. Who here can't see through what she's trying to do?"

"Trying to get junior sister blamed and condemned by everyone, right?"

"Pfft."

"If she weren't a girl, I would have slapped her face just now."

Ye Wanwan looked at both of them for a long while. Long enough that Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi started to feel a little warm in the face. Both scratched the back of their heads. "Junior sister, what's wrong?"

Were they being too subtle?

Should they go kick her twice?

Ye Wanwan's eyes went red at the rims. But she was smiling. "Thank you."

"Ah, why are you crying now?"

Li Wanzhi panicked. He wanted to wipe her tears but was afraid his hands would smudge her beautiful face or her veil.

Fang He'an also said quickly: "Don't cry, don't cry."

Neither of them had heard an explanation. But they both understood.

She had gone too long, far too long, without anyone standing up for her.

The moment Ye Qian knelt, whoever was in the wrong would be her.

The moment Ye Qian cried, whoever was bullying her would be her.

How could junior sister be wrong?

It could only be the senior sister.

The senior sister who hadn't taught her junior sister well. The senior sister who had no capacity for patience.

But this senior sister Ye Wanwan......

Was only one year older than Ye Qian.

She was also still at an age when she needed to be cared for.

Why should she have been expected to bear all of that responsibility?

Bai Jian took out the last of her snow fruits and pressed them into Ye Wanwan's hands. "Eat. They're sweet."

Ye Wanwan took them, but the tears kept coming. "Sorry...... I'm......"

She hadn't wanted to cry.

But she couldn't stop herself.

From the unconscious tears, to the large drops rolling silently down, the girl suddenly began to cry out loud. Bai Jian wrapped her arms around her at once. "Don't be afraid. Senior sister is here."

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi's eyes also reddened.

She could hide all her grievances on her own. She could face everything on her own — the sect's betrayal, her master's coldness, her senior brothers' rage, being driven out, wandering into the demon realm. She could do all of it.

Even at the end, when all seven of them had driven swords through her heart, she hadn't cried.

But when someone saw through her, and turned to protect her wholeheartedly — when Ye Wanwan opened her mouth, all the suppressed and buried emotion came pouring out like a collapsing flood.

Completely beyond control.

She had been holding on for too long. Far too long.

Too long.

The girl's crying was stifled and broken. Many people heard it. In front of the stone gate, the crowd fell quiet, one by one. They didn't know the reason. They didn't know what had happened. But in the face of that fractured and restrained sobbing, everyone instinctively went still.

More than a few had reddened eyes of their own.

They thought:

She must have......

Suffered so much. So very much.

Enough that she couldn't hold it in anymore — buried in Bai Jian's shoulder, crying with her whole heart.

chapters.title: So It Was You
chapters.content:
The girl's sobs were broken.

But she held them back with everything she had.

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi were also deeply affected.

Bai Jian held the girl and wouldn't let go.

Shen Nanzhu had been watching the girl the whole time, his eyes dark and still, saying nothing.

Only occasionally, when his gaze swept over the Supreme Sect's group, a cold light flickered through them.

Ye Wanwan's crying broke apart the atmosphere Ye Qian had deliberately cultivated.

In an instant, more than a few eyes turned toward the Supreme Sect's people with speculation. Someone murmured: "Did they do something to her? Otherwise why would she cry like that?"

A female cultivator gave a cold laugh: "Does anyone even need to ask? She'd just arrived, hadn't said a single word, and this Supreme Sect junior sister dropped to her knees right in front of her. What was that supposed to be? Misleading everyone? Hoping people would think someone had wronged her before she even opened her mouth?"

Another female cultivator said icily: "She probably assumed everyone was in the dark about what happened in the Cloud Mountain Cave — which is why she tried to pull that."

"My junior brother was in there and already told us everything. This Ye Qian got into an arrow competition with the Tianyi Sect junior sister, and lost. Then she couldn't handle losing and pushed herself past her limits, forcing nascent soul-level power out of the divine bow. Their senior brother got worried junior sister would damage her meridians, so he ambushed the Tianyi Sect junior sister with golden core peak strength. It was the Tianyi Sect junior brother who shielded her with his life that brought her back."

"I heard about it too. The reason Ji Changhuai got injured so badly was because the Tianyi Sect senior sister got angry and released the Vast Sky Strike. That's why he took such serious damage."

"He deserved it!"

"If your own junior sister can't handle losing, pull her away and admit defeat properly. Ambushing someone else — and then he wonders why her senior sister came for revenge?"

"Then what was this Ye Qian doing, kneeling in front of the Tianyi Sect junior sister? She drove her own senior brother to get injured out of stubborn pride, and now she's going to kneel and beg for mercy?"

"Classic pre-emptive strike. She speaks first. Anyone who doesn't know what happened might assume the Tianyi Sect junior sister did something to her senior brother. Once she's spoken, by the time Tianyi Sect tries to explain, it's already too late."

"That's...... a very calculated mind."

Several female cultivators pieced it together for everyone else, and others, once they asked around, confirmed that this was indeed the case. Wang Niu also called out loudly: "And there's something nobody knows yet — everyone was able to wake up from the dreamscape because the Tianyi Sect junior sister helped! Her sword broke through the sealed entrance of the dream and saved everyone!"

"She saved my little brother and Brother Li!"

"So that's what happened."

The crowd stirred. The looks turned toward Ye Wanwan were considerably warmer.

As for Ye Wanwan having obtained the parasitic spirit — Wang Niu didn't mention a single word of that.

Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming had gone pale. The former had no strength left. The latter could still move — but at this moment, Dou Ming's face had gone from white to red, burning with the pointed accusations coming from all sides.

"You don't know anything!" Dou Ming shouted. "These people colluded and ganged up on us while our senior brother wasn't on guard. They poisoned us — that's why we ended up like this!"

"What kind of righteous cultivator uses poison? They're evil cultivators!"

A certain sect that combined medicine and poison cultivation: "......"

Was he implying something about them?

"Friend Dou's words are a bit extreme. Medicine and poison are two sides of the same thing — poison is a branch of medicine. The question is how the user applies it. Using poison doesn't make someone evil."

"So what if you use poison? In the immortal cultivation world, the strong prey on the weak. If you lose, you lose — blaming others for being evil cultivators is just embarrassing."

Dou Ming's face went redder. "I wasn't talking about you — I meant him!"

Fang He'an found himself suddenly pointed at.

"......"

Fang He'an nearly laughed in disbelief. But he kept his expression completely innocent. "My spirit root is a little unusual, yes. But I also have something to say. When your junior sister shot arrows at my senior sister without warning, was I not allowed to fight back?"

"Am I not allowed to protect my own senior sisters and junior sisters?"

Fang He'an stepped forward, holding Dou Ming's gaze steadily.

Dou Ming insisted: "But you used poison!"

"I said — my spirit root is unusual. Once I use it, I can't control what it does. At that moment, in a desperate situation, to protect my senior sister who had already exhausted herself, it was the only thing I could do. After all, I'm an alchemist — I really have no other means of self-defense."

Fang He'an turned to the crowd and clasped his hands with a sigh. "I really am sorry for what everyone had to witness. My spirit root is just naturally different from others'. I know this kind of power causes serious harm. But I was at my wit's end — if I hadn't acted, my senior sister would have died right then and there, and I truly didn't......" Fang He'an pressed at the corner of his eye and choked slightly: "I didn't know what else to do."

Playing the victim?

Who couldn't?

Li Wanzhi plopped down on the ground with complete ease and said without any trace of shame: "Senior brother, it's pointless. We're a small, insignificant little sect. No one will listen to us. They're the Supreme Sect — the supreme, untouchable Supreme Sect! One of the top three! If they want to bully people like us, two sentences is all it takes. We were clearly defending ourselves, and they still think we got the better of the deal."

Fang He'an also sighed. "It's because we haven't worked hard enough."

Li Wanzhi: "Exactly."

The crowd: "......"

Everyone's feelings were complicated.

What were these two geniuses doing, performing this helpless underdog act? Wasn't it one of them who just said anyone who didn't break through golden core by fifteen was a waste?

Li Wanzhi: "? Where do rumors like that come from!"

Dou Ming was backed into a corner, couldn't out-argue Li Wanzhi or Fang He'an, felt his blood and energy rush upward — and suddenly he coughed up a mouthful of blood.

Everyone jumped.

Li Wanzhi quickly stepped away. "Hey hey hey — this has nothing to do with us. He choked on his own anger."

Ji Changhuai looked at the spectacle, his voice hoarse. "Junior sister, come back."

Everyone suddenly noticed — Ye Qian was still kneeling.

Ye Qian's eyes were full of tears as she looked at Ji Changhuai. She struggled to her feet and limped toward him.

Li Wanzhi watched and said, puzzled: "They're cultivators. Did kneeling actually snap a bone?"

The crowd: "......"

Ye Qian: "......"

There it was — whatever thin thread of sympathy had begun to emerge was snapped by Li Wanzhi's words. Ye Qian made her shaky way back to Ji Changhuai's side, tears still falling. "I only wanted to get the antidote for senior brother."

Ji Changhuai had been about to reprimand her — but at those words, he couldn't find it in himself. He said hoarsely: "Let it go."

At this moment, someone spoke up. "I know this isn't the most tactful thing to say, but I......"

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi looked over simultaneously: "If you know it's not tactful, why say it?"

Qi Minglu: "......"

Qi Minglu gritted his teeth and pressed on: "I still want to say something fair. Everyone came in here together for the trials. We were rivals during the process, yes — but now that it's over, we'll walk out as members of the same alliance again. Ji senior brother and Friend Dou have clearly lost. Isn't it better to give them the antidote? Leaving them like this when we go out doesn't look good for anyone."

Li Yun heard this and found himself agreeing.

However you looked at it, that was the Supreme Sect.

Offending the Supreme Sect wouldn't benefit anyone here. Others might even be dragged into their resentment.

With everyone's supporting eyes on him, Qi Minglu felt increasingly justified and reasonable.

Li Wanzhi stared at this smug, long face in front of him and recognized it — this was Qi Minglu from the inn, the one who had used illusion techniques and mocked them.

"Still running that foul mouth."

Qi Minglu: ?

A hoarse female voice rang out: "The antidote can be given."

Everyone turned toward Ye Wanwan. The girl had already composed herself. Her eyes were still reddened at the edges — but her expression was completely calm.

Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming also looked toward Ye Wanwan.

Ye Wanwan looked at Ye Qian. "Admit fault. Apologize."

"And I'll give you the antidote."

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi said in chorus: "Correct!"

"Admit fault and apologize!"

Neither Qi Minglu nor Li Yun could find a way to object. Just an admission of fault and an apology — that was hardly an unreasonable demand.

But this one demand made Ye Qian stand frozen in place, unable to move. It was as if lightning had struck her. Her lips trembled. Her whole body shook.

"It's you!"

So it really was you!!

Ye Wanwan!

chapters.title: I'm Taking Back What's Mine
chapters.content:
Ye Wanwan.

The name nearly burst from Ye Qian's lips. Even looking into the girl's eyes, she could see it — that familiar cold detachment, that effortless sense of superiority, just like the first time they had met.

That girl, standing on the white jade steps, looking down at her. Brows like a painting, eyes bright, standing among Ji Changhuai and the others in flowing robes — like a jewel cradled in devoted hands.

Back then, she had dropped her gaze, thoughtful, and asked: "So you're the new junior sister?"

It was her!

Just her!

She had done this on purpose!

Every part of Ye Qian was screaming it. This was revenge for the day at Mirror Lake when Master had forced her to admit fault. She was going to make her bow her head.

Make her kneel on the ground and beg forgiveness.

Kneel before her!

Humiliate her!

"I won't!" Ye Qian's voice trembled, but it was resolute. "I did nothing wrong."

This surprised even Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming.

Even Li Yun and Qi Minglu were taken aback. Why was she being stubborn again?

It was just admitting fault, wasn't it?

Ye Qian's expression twisted slightly. Her voice dropped low and cold. "Within the secret realm, treasure belongs to whoever has the ability to take it. I lost to you — but I did nothing wrong."

"Winning and losing in a match — that's normal. Isn't it, Tianyi Sect senior sister?"

Ye Qian put deliberate weight on those words "senior sister." She knew Ye Wanwan would understand.

Ye Wanwan did. She curved her lips. "So what exactly are you saying?"

Ye Qian seemed to drop all pretense. She stopped playing the role. "You and your senior brothers poisoned us — isn't it because you don't want us to spread word that you took the secret realm's spirit? You want to silence us!"

"The secret realm's spirit?"

The crowd erupted.

"Does she mean the companion spirit that forms within a secret realm after a thousand years — the formation spirit that can control the realm and allow free travel within it?"

"If they got that, they've been moving around collecting resources this whole time......"

"So that's why they arrived at the stone gate so late......"

Eyes began to drift toward the rings and qian kun pouches on Ye Wanwan and Bai Jian's hands. Could those be full of treasures?

The restless gazes around them started shifting forward. More than a few had thoughts of taking advantage of the chaos.

Li Wanzhi immediately got to his feet, eyes sharp. Bai Jian and Fang He'an also went stone-faced. Shen Nanzhu had already moved without being noticed, positioning himself beside Bai Jian and the others, standing with them.

But then the girl's laughter rang out — short, cold, and clear. "And then what?"

She stepped out.

Talisman lines appeared beneath her feet.

A formation spread out from where she stood.

With her second step.

Boom.

Streams of light shot skyward.

A formation sealed the entire area in front of the stone gate.

Ye Wanwan swept her gaze across everyone present, one by one. Everyone who met her eyes stepped back — because the aura pouring off Ye Wanwan now was —

Nascent soul!

Nascent soul mid-stage!

Ye Qian went chalk-white. "You......"

How was this possible!

How could this be nascent soul!

The girl moved, appearing before Ye Qian in an instant. She gripped Ye Qian by the throat, slowly tightening her hold. She murmured in a low, silken voice: "I really do want to just choke you to death here."

Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming charged forward without thinking. But the girl's voice fell cold: "Kneel."

Thud.

Both of them dropped to their knees. The sound of kneecaps striking stone made everyone's teeth ache.

Everyone else stumbled back by another step.

Two steps.

Three steps.

Ye Wanwan swept her gaze across them. Her cold smile was thin. "Anyone who wants to take something — come forward. I promise I will kill you one by one."

"Kill you and bury you myself."

The girl's voice still carried a smile as she said it. But everyone felt their skin prickle.

Ye Qian croaked in a raspy voice: "She's using a forbidden technique...... forcing...... a cultivation surge......"

"Don't...... be afraid......"

Ye Wanwan tightened her grip. The crowd watched Ye Qian's face slowly turn violet, unable to draw breath. The spiritual energy around her couldn't be used at all under the crushing pressure of Ye Wanwan's nascent soul aura.

Everyone just watched. Watched Ye Wanwan looking as though she was going to choke Ye Qian to death right here.

Ye Qian thought so too.

But Ye Wanwan didn't.

She lowered her voice near Ye Qian's ear: "Did you think I'd just kill you like this? Don't be naive. The suffering you made me go through — I'm not going to let you escape so easily."

Ye Qian's pupils contracted. "You're going to......"

Do what.

Ye Wanwan's other hand pressed against Ye Qian's abdomen.

"What's mine — I'm taking it back, of course."

The girl's words were utterly light. But Ye Qian trembled all over. She screamed: "No——"

A hand plunged through.

A wet, tearing sound.

Blood-soaked. Even though that hand was slender and delicate and beautiful.

She had still reached through the other person's dantian.

And pulled out a golden core.

A gasp swept through the entire front of the Dim Light Stone Gate.

"She dug out the core!"

Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming stared, stunned, unable to believe what they were seeing. But they couldn't stand — all they could do was watch as Ye Wanwan withdrew Ye Qian's golden core.

That small golden core sat in the girl's palm.

A deep, luminous blue. Suffused with pure water elemental force.

And it made no attempt to resist.

Li Yun shouted toward Bai Jian and the others: "Tianyi Sect — what are you doing?! We are all righteous, established sects! Are you going to just stand by and let your junior sister tear out someone else's golden core?!"

"Evil cultivators!"

"This is absolutely an evil cultivation sect!"

"Everyone together — help the Supreme Sect junior sister get justice!"

"If it's her core today, it'll be ours next!"

Some people tried to surge forward. The formation snapped out and hurled them backward. More than ten people were launched away, crashing down and coughing up blood. The sight froze everyone else in place.

Bai Jian, Fang He'an, and Li Wanzhi didn't move.

Not only that — they were coldly watching every person who showed the slightest sign of acting.

"You're all insane!" someone shouted.

"Insane?" Ye Wanwan heard this and laughed. A short, cold, sharp sound. "Who was it that really dug out a golden core? Ji Changhuai!" Ye Wanwan's voice cut upward. "Do you dare say whose core this is?"

The name called out, Ji Changhuai went chalk-white. He stared at Ye Wanwan blankly.

"You......"

Ye Wanwan looked at him coldly. "Do you dare say?"

Ji Changhuai's body began to shake. It was as though some possibility had occurred to him — even his lips trembled. "No. Impossible. You can't be......"

Dou Ming stared blankly at Ye Wanwan and Ji Changhuai.

He hadn't yet understood what was happening.

But he knew one thing!

——He had to save Ye Qian!

"Release junior sister!"

"I will. But not now."

Ye Wanwan gave a cold laugh. She gripped the golden core. Compressed under the force of a nascent soul cultivator, it spun frantically. Water elemental force pulsed and surged — but was still held fast in the girl's hand.

Until it could no longer withstand that magnitude of force. With a crack.

Everyone jumped.

They thought Ye Wanwan had crushed it.

But as the water elemental force within the core ran dry, with a sudden burst of light, something emerged from inside the golden core — something smaller, more refined.

And it was — fire.

The crowd was stunned.

Li Yun was dumbfounded.

Qi Minglu's mouth fell open. The tiny golden core on Ye Wanwan's palm, impossibly pure and refined, burned like a small flame — leaping, joyful, dancing around Ye Wanwan.

As if it had found its rightful owner.

chapters.title: Others Can't — But I Can
chapters.content:
The scene had become rather strange.

From a golden core pulled from the water-root Ye Qian — what emerged was fire element.

The sharp reversal left many people's minds spinning. But those who were more experienced understood at once. "Core transference."

"An attribute shift?"

"Yes. Using a special method to convert the five-element alignment of a golden core."

"There's a method like that? So cores between different elemental alignments can be substituted? But what about the spirit root? The spirit roots are different — doesn't that cause problems?"

"It does. Ideally you'd substitute a core from the same element. But if one isn't available, a core of a higher grade will also work."

Li Yun said quietly: "Using transference drops the grade by one tier."

"Right. Peak-grade drops to high-grade. High-grade drops to mid-grade. So normally no one would do this."

"Then to preserve a peak-grade core, you'd need......"

"You'd need heaven-......"

Heaven-grade.

Everyone went quiet. After a moment, someone couldn't help asking in a hushed voice: "Where would she get a golden core from a heaven-grade spirit root cultivator? And even if she had one, who would give up a heaven-grade core for someone else's peak-grade?"

Right — who would throw away a heaven-grade core for a peak-grade?

Wasn't that a complete waste?

Heaven-grade was so rare. You couldn't find one among ten thousand talented cultivators.

"Fire element, heaven-grade — isn't this from Qingyun Peak's junior sister?"

"But Qingyun Peak's junior sister is Ye Qian, isn't it?"

"No — there was another one, Seventh Junior Sister, but a lot of people confused them. I heard that senior sister died of illness last year though. It's been a long time since anyone heard about her."

"Did she really die of illness?"

The thought flickered through everyone's mind.

Cultivators didn't fall ill that easily.

This time, the looks turned toward Ji Changhuai and Dou Ming carried a new and significant weight.

The Supreme Sect might not be quite as clean as they appeared.

But regardless — Ye Wanwan had torn out Ye Qian's golden core in front of every cultivator present. This was genuinely shocking. And this was not something a righteous cultivator was supposed to do.

While the crowd's condemning gazes pressed down on Ye Wanwan, Dou Ming had seized the moment. He detonated a magic artifact, breaking free of Ye Wanwan's aura suppression.

He roared: "Stone Prison!"

Countless rocks burst from the earth, surging toward Ye Wanwan alone. Sharp stone spires erupted between Ye Qian and Ye Wanwan, driving straight at the girl's wrist.

If Ye Wanwan didn't dodge, she'd be struck.

If she dodged, she'd have to release Ye Qian.

Dou Ming was counting on exactly this to force her to let go.

Ye Wanwan glanced at him. Her voice was flat: "I said. I will let go."

The girl raised her hand and drove the spikes back. The single rebound made Dou Ming spit a mouthful of blood.

But Ye Wanwan released Ye Qian and tossed her toward the rushing Dou Ming. He caught her — Ye Qian still bleeding profusely — his eyes red. But also afraid.

"Junior sister."

"Junior sister, don't be frightened. Senior brother will treat your injuries."

Ye Qian was still coughing up blood. "Third...... third senior brother."

Ye Wanwan said calmly: "No need to act as if you're on the brink of death. An injury like that won't kill her."

Dou Ming shrieked: "I'm going to kill you! I'm going to kill you!"

Ye Wanwan gave a low, mocking laugh: "Haven't you done that before?"

Dou Ming's eyes were wild with fury. He couldn't comprehend it — why would anyone hate them this much? His palms brimmed with spiritual energy. The ground trembled slightly.

Ye Wanwan just laughed quietly: "Looking for death?"

"Then you go first!"

Dou Ming roared!

Every rock on the ground shuddered and cracked, a massive shockwave tearing outward. It hammered against Ye Wanwan's formation — and against the footing of everyone from Tianyi Sect.

Dou Ming seized the opening, setting Ye Qian down and charging at Ye Wanwan. "Senior brother, give me a hand!"

If they could break her formation, Dou Ming was confident he could kill this woman!

Ji Changhuai's body shook. "But......"

But......

Dou Ming bellowed: "Don't you want to avenge junior sister?!"

"Junior sister's core was taken!"

Taken by someone from outside the sect!

He kept moving even as he shouted, dodging the formation's force. He kept unleashing earth quakes, and then called down "Rock Barrage."

Bang, bang, bang.

Rocks rained down in front of the entire stone gate. The ground was reduced to wreckage. A complete ruin.

In the ruins, Dou Ming kept his gaze locked on Ye Wanwan, using the destruction of the earth to erode the formation, closing the distance between them bit by bit. Even under the crushing pressure of the formation.

Dou Ming didn't stop.

"He has a magic artifact on him," Fang He'an said, identifying it immediately.

Li Wanzhi asked anxiously: "What do we do?"

Fang He'an couldn't get through to interfere either.

But he knew one thing — junior sister's cultivation had been forcibly elevated somehow. It couldn't be sustained for long.

"We need to find an opening."

Ye Wanwan wove calmly through the ruins, evading. But her gaze was rapidly searching for Dou Ming's weakness. Dou Ming was famous as the undisputed king of ground combat.

Fighting him on flat earth was indeed somewhat disadvantageous.

But if she left the formation, she would have fallen right into his trap.

So Ye Wanwan didn't leave.

And Dou Ming's goal was exactly for her to stay.

As the earth shaking expanded in range, an enormous cage, condensed from mid-air, suddenly appeared overhead — directly above Ye Wanwan. The crowd gasped.

Dou Ming's eyes went cold. "Die."

"Go underground and repent for your sins."

Ye Wanwan looked at him calmly. "A high-low double attack, is it? You've learned well. But have you forgotten who it was that taught you how to do this?"

Dou Ming: "......"

Ye Wanwan seemed to be speaking to herself: "And the counter is simple enough, isn't it. Third. Senior. Brother."

That one word at a time, full of mockery, made Dou Ming's pupils shrink.

Ye Wanwan stepped out of the cage's path — just as it finished forming above her, she vanished. In the next instant the cage appeared above Dou Ming.

Dou Ming's head snapped up. He understood that with a tracking cage over his head —

That meant——

Dou Ming spun around.

Ye Wanwan was directly behind him.

"Third Senior Brother, your idea of a high-low trap is good — but the speed is too slow. If the opponent appears behind you at maximum speed and locks on to you before you can react — what do you do?" The girl's clear voice rang right at his ear. Dou Ming remembered his own answer at the time: "No one would be that fast."

Ye Wanwan had smiled and said: "But I can."

Dou Ming turned. He looked into the girl's eyes, and the discomfort he had always felt around her finally crystallized into understanding.

"Se......ven......"

Junior sister.

The cage fell. But at the last moment, the girl had already stepped out.

She stood one step outside the cage.

Standing inside the cage, Dou Ming looked out at the girl standing beyond. He watched her speak with complete calm: "Rock Barrage."

The technique was his — but spoken from her mouth, there was a quality of perfect ease and mastery about it. In the high air, black fissures tore open. Countless rocks came crashing down.

And struck the cage.

The ground shook across the entire area.

The girl turned away calmly. She didn't look back.

The direction she walked was toward Bai Jian and the others.

With the Dim Light Stone Gate blazing with light, everyone understood.

"It's over."

chapters.title: Backing
chapters.content:
The Dim Light Stone Gate opened.

Every disciple still inside the secret realm felt a summons pull at them.

One by one they disappeared from where they stood. Everyone understood — the trials were over.

Ye Wanwan walked toward Bai Jian and the others, her spine straight, not looking back.

Even though the place where Dou Ming had stood was now a ruin.

Even though someone behind her was calling out.

"Ju...... nior sister......"

Ye Wanwan still didn't turn around. She knew who was calling.

Ji Changhuai had forced out those words with great difficulty.

But Ye Wanwan was past caring.

She didn't need to be their junior sister anymore.

Ye Wanwan walked step by step toward Bai Jian and the others, and held out her hand. "Let's go."

Bai Jian, Fang He'an, and Li Wanzhi all looked at her.

The girl's face was a little pale.

None of them dared ask about her condition here. All three took hold of her hand. Fang He'an didn't forget to drag Shen Nanzhu along.

All five together, they felt the summons — and disappeared from where they stood.

When they came out again.

They were at the foot of Dream Marsh Mountain.

Every young disciple who had left the secret realm was here. Everyone who looked at Ye Wanwan did so with a mix of bewilderment and furtive pointing.

"That's her — the one who tore out the Supreme Sect junior sister's golden core. She also critically injured Friend Dou."

"I just saw Ji Gongzi and the others come out too. Three Supreme Sect disciples came in this time — all three critically injured, one who lost her core. There's no way they'll let this rest."

"Don't say it out loud, I can see the Supreme Sect elders heading over."

"Keep your distance from her."

Whatever others said, the girl stood straight. Her slender frame was already ahead of Bai Jian and the others, shielding them. And when she felt a powerful aura bearing down, Ye Wanwan was the first to step forward.

But Bai Jian caught her hand.

Ye Wanwan looked at Bai Jian's hand. She said quietly: "Senior sister. This mess I made......"

"Don't worry," Bai Jian said softly. As she spoke, Fang He'an, Li Wanzhi, and Shen Nanzhu stepped out in turn. All three positioned themselves so that both girls were shielded in the middle.

Bai Jian's gaze was gentle but absolute. "Tianyi Sect never abandons any one of its brothers or sisters."

Ye Wanwan looked at the four people around her. She couldn't help curving her eyes into a smile. Of course she knew — this time, she wouldn't be left behind. But how could she bear to see them get hurt for her sake?

The powerful aura that had been hurtling toward them from the distance, carrying world-shattering force, came crashing down from above.

"Filth. You deserve to die!"

Ye Wanwan said: "Let me take this one."

The girl spoke, channeled everything in her body, and transformed into a streak of light that flew out from their protective circle, planting herself in the air above. She pressed her hands together in a seal. Five golden cores flew out and locked into formation.

A vast five-element formation array interposed itself beneath the enormous golden palm above!

Clang!

The titanic collision shook the girl's body.

But her gaze was still unwavering. With a clear and cold shout: "I — did nothing wrong! Ye Qian took my core — I took back what was mine. There is no wrong in that."

"Yanding's heart is blind and his eyes are sealed. He colluded with the Ye family, drove his own disciple to her death, and taught no one worth teaching. This — is what he deserves!"

"The Supreme Sect tolerates and protects wrongdoing. Their sect master abuses his position. You are unworthy of calling yourselves righteous!"

"I give you a single word!"

"Deserved!"

Elder Wuzhen listened to each declaration with disbelief.

Watching the girl speak one accusation after another, even as she coughed up blood, even as her aura grew weaker — her eyes blazed like stars, bright as fire!

She was still smiling. "One extra word. On the house."

"You all."

"Had it coming."

Elder Wuzhen exploded with rage. The full power of his nascent soul stage bore down. The girl's five spinning golden cores began to tremble — and then seemed on the verge of shattering.

Ye Wanwan could hold on no longer. She coughed up blood.

Bai Jian and Shen Nanzhu charged out together.

Fang He'an screamed at the top of his lungs: "Senior uncle! Senior uncle! Someone's bullying us!"

Li Wanzhi bellowed: "Master! They're going to kill junior sister!"

Both of them roared from the very depths of their lungs.

Their voices hadn't faded when a sword aura tore across the sky — nascent soul-level force, directly ripping through the void and shattering the massive golden palm. Elder Wuzhen's expression changed.

What powerful sword energy!

In the wake of the sword energy, Yan Qu flashed into place before Ye Wanwan. One look at the girl's state, and his expression went from fury to alarm.

"Third senior brother — would you please get over here!"

Yan Qu's voice rang out.

"Dammit, I just went to use the latrine! How did the gate open already!"

Before Wuzhen could react, a terrifying aura surged in. The enormous golden palm collapsed under the impact of that force. Wuzhen's expression went to shock and disbelief.

That aura......

Was absolutely above nascent soul level!

Xun Yin came charging out directly, appearing in mid-air. He took one look at Ye Wanwan drenched in blood, and his heart dropped several degrees.

Finished. If Pei Xuan that bastard finds out I let things with his disciple get this bad, he'll tear me apart.

No chance of borrowing spirit stones from him anymore.

"Little one, quick, quick — eat this." Xun Yin immediately found a pill and pressed it into Ye Wanwan's hands. "Calm down, calm down. Don't get upset. What's worth all this rage?"

"Want to hit someone? Senior uncle will do the hitting for you."

Ye Wanwan couldn't speak, but warm spiritual energy kept being channeled steadily into her body. She saw Yan Qu helping her as well. "Sorry......"

"I think I've...... caused everyone trouble."

Xun Yin only got angrier at that. "You child — someone hits you and you still find a way to put the responsibility on yourself? Don't you know how to shift the blame? Instead of guilt and self-criticism, why not blame someone else? What's with all this moral self-flagellation?"

Ye Wanwan wanted to laugh, but couldn't quite manage it.

The people of Tianyi Sect — their way of thinking was a little unusual.

But they were all wonderful.

"Stay with your senior sisters and brothers here. Senior uncle will avenge you." Xe Wanwan was passed into the care of Bai Jian and Fang He'an, and Xun Yin turned back to sweep a gaze across Elder Wuzhen. Frost radiated from him.

"So you're the one who hit our little one, are you?"

Elder Wuzhen felt a jolt of warning and sensed trouble — but before long, two more people arrived. They said coldly: "Friend, please be clear on the facts. It was your Tianyi Sect people who first shattered our senior nephew's golden core."

Xun Yin wore the expression of someone hearing absolute nonsense. He launched into a tirade: "Inside the secret realm, everyone signed life-and-death contracts. Your senior nephew could have died in there fair and square — that's his own lack of ability, and he deserved it! Your young ones couldn't win, so now the old ones come crawling out? Fine."

Xun Yin revealed a cold, glacial smile. "Then don't blame me for fighting dirty against you."

Xun Yin released his aura. The seemingly ragged, carefree old man in plain clothes — the aura he released was absolutely terrifying.

The entire Dream Marsh Mountain seemed to be crushed under that pressure. Beasts cried and howled. Even the ground shook. Xun Yin pointed at Wuzhen, his voice carrying a bone-deep chill: "You hit my little senior-niece once. I'm not asking for much in return. Take three palms from me. If you're still alive after three, I'll spare your mangy life."

His voice finished.

The palm force from above came crashing down. Wuzhen, a nascent soul cultivator, was driven from the air straight into the ground. A booming impact. A crater a hundred meters deep. Bone-chilling cold seeping up from within it.

The entire area went silent.

Spirit...... Void Refinement......

The realm beyond nascent soul — Void Refinement.

Someone stronger than Yanding himself.

chapters.title: You're the Senior, I'm the Junior
chapters.content:
Qi refinement. Foundation establishment. Core formation. Nascent soul. Spirit transformation.

And then — Void Refinement.

A Void Refinement cultivator, stronger than Yanding himself.

Ye Wanwan looked at Xun Yin's back. In this moment, she felt a security she had never felt before. Yan Qu seemed to have noticed her worry — and the weight she had been carrying to keep her aura from collapsing.

For the first time, Yan Qu felt genuine admiration for a young person. And along with it, a deep tenderness.

"No one is going to harm them. Don't worry."

Ye Wanwan had been afraid that her reckless actions would implicate Bai Jian and the others.

Which was why she had held on.

Ye Wanwan asked softly: "Can I sleep now......"

Li Wanzhi broke at those words. He couldn't hold on. "What kind of question is that — sleep! If you want to sleep, sleep!"

But Ye Wanwan still looked at Yan Qu, stubborn, waiting for an answer.

Yan Qu understood. She wanted a promise.

Yan Qu said: "Sleep. Senior uncle guarantees — when you wake up, you'll be in Tianyi Sect."

Only then did Ye Wanwan seem to relax. She murmured: "Senior uncle, I miss the snow mountain......"

"I miss...... Master too......"

The girl closed her eyes and sank into sleep.

Yan Qu's hands slowly tightened. He swept a cold gaze over the gathering forces on the other side. His voice dropped to ice: "Supreme Sect. Everyone, step out."

The Cang Thunder Sword was drawn.

Thunder light crackled. The young man stood at the foot of Dream Marsh Mountain, already leveled by Xun Yin. His voice rang out cold: "All of you. Get out here!"

From that day on, everyone knew: if you wanted to fight Tianyi Sect, you could try. But if you hurt the young ones, the older ones would come for you.

The older ones would come. And behind them — someone even older.

Yan Qu and Xun Yin, enraged on Ye Wanwan's behalf, leveled Dream Marsh Mountain.

And shook the entire Dream Marsh City and the immortal cultivation world.

But Ye Wanwan knew none of this. Yan Qu had not lied. When she woke up, it was indeed inside a Tianyi Sect mountain cavern.

Only the girl was still groggy, unable to open her eyes no matter how she tried.

She could vaguely hear movement around her. She could hear Xun Yin's cursing and quiet apologetic laughter — Master seemed to be angry. And the sect master senior uncle was mediating.

"Third brother and little Yanqu already crippled that whole lot. You going to Wushang Sect to stomp their gate looks a bit hard to explain. Even though senior brother also thinks stomping it is fine — but there's no good excuse."

"Bear with it."

"We've already called the fifth one back. He's bringing medicine this time. It'll definitely heal the little girl."

"Ah, what an ordeal. Forcibly elevating her cultivation like that. How could she not value herself — just like you."

Ye Wanwan didn't know what Pei Xuan said. But she could hear that Master was speaking up for her. She closed her eyes again and went back under. She slept for a very long time.

And slept very soundly.

In two lifetimes, she had never once slept this soundly.

Like bare feet in the grass, sky a clear blue, lake water green, the grass soft and alive — like the heaven and earth she had spent years communing with, and also the kind of sleep she had dreamed of for years.

She had found where she belonged.

Where her heart lived.

Tianyi Sect.

Ye Wanwan woke up one month later. The first thing she saw upon waking was Li Wanzhi's eyes, red and swollen from crying.

"Junior sister, I told you to sleep — not to sleep that long. If you keep sleeping like this, everyone's going to stop being able to hold back Pei Xuan senior uncle."

"Master said at that point it would be two sects going to war."

"I'm not afraid of dying on the battlefield — I'm afraid you won't get to see me in my heroic glory on the battlefield."

"Wuwuwu, wake up already."

Ye Wanwan opened her eyes and looked at him for quite a while. Only then did Li Wanzhi register — the girl was awake.

He yelped and bounced a full three feet off the ground.

"She's awake! She's awake!"

His voice raw from screaming, Li Wanzhi ran from the room to the courtyard and bellowed into the mountain ranges. By the time Ye Wanwan called out to stop him, the room already had a new visitor.

Silver-white hair. Silver robes.

Like colors that had seeped into the snowmountain itself.

Even his features were faint and understated.

He stood three paces away, looking at Ye Wanwan. Like he was inspecting her from head to toe, making sure she was intact. Then his gaze settled on her face. He frowned.

"What happened to your pride."

"You couldn't win, and you didn't know to call for help?"

Ye Wanwan had been pressing her lips together. Pei Xuan was frowning too, seeming to wonder if he'd been too stern and frightened her.

Ye Wanwan's eyes reddened at the edges. But she was smiling. "But Master — I didn't know how to call."

"I've never done it before."

"......" Pei Xuan's lips moved. He managed not to say anything harsh in front of his disciple. With no change in expression, he raised his hand and sent a streak of light into the disciple token at the bedside. A seal made from his own primordial spirit was now embedded in it.

"Next time you can't win — call me directly."

Ye Wanwan nodded. "All right."

With that said, Pei Xuan didn't know what else to say.

The two of them went quiet together.

Outside of cultivation, master and disciple had apparently never talked about much else.

Pei Xuan didn't know how to find a new topic either. Especially with the little girl sitting on the bed, so gentle and well-behaved — so different from her usual stubborn look of trying to prove herself. He couldn't just open with telling her to go practice in the snow.

Luckily, Bai Jian and Fang He'an and the others had already come up. Pei Xuan said, keeping his tone mild: "They've been coming by every day during this time. They certainly have things to say to you. I won't disturb you."

He finished speaking — and vanished where he stood.

Li Wanzhi burst in, and had barely gotten "senior uncle" out before Pei Xuan was already gone. Li Wanzhi was baffled. "Why did senior uncle run off so fast?"

"Junior sister!" Fang He'an came in like a gust of wind and threw himself down at Ye Wanwan's bedside, about to start wailing — and was swept aside by Bai Jian's sleeve.

Fang He'an: "......"

Bai Jian took Ye Wanwan's cold hands in hers. Before she could say a word, tears were already falling.

Ye Wanwan reached up and wiped them. "Senior sister — you can't be a crybaby."

Bai Jian nodded hard, then said: "You can't go charging ahead alone. If you can't win, there's us — there's Master too. We do it together."

"All right."

Bai Jian thought of something else, raised her head and looked at Ye Wanwan, repeating each word clearly: "And you weren't wrong. What's yours — you should take it back."

"If you still want revenge, we'll go to the Supreme Sect and drag the people back for you."

Bai Jian's gaze burned as she looked at Ye Wanwan. Waiting for her answer. If she nodded, Bai Jian would go.

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi would too.

"We're senior brothers and sisters. What happens to you happens to us. If you want something, say the word — we'll go without question."

Ye Wanwan looked at all of them. Saw the sincerity in their eyes. She suddenly reached out and wrapped her arms around Bai Jian. Her voice was quiet. "I don't need anything else. Having you is enough."

Ye Wanwan looked at Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi too, and said again: "Having you is enough."

Fang He'an scratched his head, embarrassed.

Li Wanzhi made a few flustered sounds and said in a twisting, reluctant voice: "Junior sister, you're going to make your Fourth Senior Brother blush, you know. After all, Senior Brother is still unattached."

Bai Jian and Fang He'an: "Get lost!"

Ye Wanwan listened to Li Wanzhi getting scolded and smacked, and couldn't help wanting to laugh.

The noise and liveliness in the room chased off the snow mountain's cold silence. Looking at all of them, Ye Wanwan became aware of a certain gaze.

She looked up and found Shen Nanzhu standing at the doorway.

The young man was quietly watching the warmth inside the room, something unreadable in his expression. His gaze carried longing — and a fear that no one else had noticed.

He wanted to come closer. But didn't dare.

Ye Wanwan spoke: "Fifth Senior Brother."

Everyone in the room went still and looked out.

Shen Nanzhu's body stiffened slightly. He turned with difficulty, and his gaze met Ye Wanwan's. She grinned — the grin of a child who had just pulled off a successful prank. "My disciple token is ranked sixth."

Shen Nanzhu: "......"

"You're the senior."

"I'm the junior."

chapters.title: A Gesture of Feeling
chapters.content:
Seniority among disciples was determined by their disciple tokens.

Ye Wanwan had found the three inches by which she could keep Shen Nanzhou in check.

Shen Nanzhou, however, looked entirely unbothered. "It's just a form of address. If Senior Sister prefers, I don't mind being called Junior Sister either."

Ye Wanwan: "......"

Still being stubborn about it.

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi, on the other hand, were studying Shen Nanzhou with genuine interest. "Dressing as a woman?"

Shen Nanzhou: "......"

"Want to try it?"

The two of them exchanged a look the moment the words left their mouths and lunged straight for Shen Nanzhou. He dodged immediately. The two chased him for a long while without so much as brushing the hem of his robe.

Shen Nanzhou shook his head, trying to put an end to this farce.

Ye Wanwan and Bai Jian exchanged a look of their own. The two of them were perfectly in sync.

Bai Jian stepped forward and appeared suddenly behind Shen Nanzhou. Shen Nanzhou turned around at once, but Bai Jian had already smoothly extended her hand and shoved him.

Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an, who had been standing behind Shen Nanzhou, let out a shout: "Got him!"

Li Wanzhi was practically vibrating with excitement. "Let's see where you run to now!"

Shen Nanzhou: "......"

Bai Jian looked at Shen Nanzhou, now pinned on both sides, and tilted her head. "You spend all day dodging around. No fun."

Shen Nanzhou frowned, looking as though he wanted to say something, but in the end let Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi drape themselves over him from either side. He looked somewhat displeased.

Fang He'an didn't care in the least. "Little Sixth Junior Brother, we've been coming to the snow mountain every day, and so have you — so why not come inside? Feeling shy?"

Shen Nanzhou: "I am not."

Li Wanzhi clicked his tongue. "One look at that sour face of his and you know that even if he was, he'd never admit it. Little Junior Sister, let me tell you — the day you passed out, my master went charging up after the Wushang Sect to settle scores. He also took the chaos as cover and snuck up to stab Ji Changhuai, nearly got himself beaten half to death for it, and Senior Uncle Xunyin had to physically drag him back."

Ye Wanwan startled. "He stabbed Ji Changhuai?"

"Why?"

Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an turned to Shen Nanzhou, still hanging off him. "Little Junior Brother, say it — why?"

Aware that all four of them were looking at him, Shen Nanzhou turned his face away. "No reason. I didn't like the look of him."

Fang He'an pressed his head down and got right up to his face. "Why are you so stubbornly awkward about everything?"

Shen Nanzhou had never been treated with this kind of casual familiarity before. He shot upward, sending Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an stumbling back. Li Wanzhi clutched his arm with a yelp. "My internal organs — injured."

Shen Nanzhou's expression was cold. "Go ahead and pretend."

With that, he walked away.

Fang He'an shook his head. "Still a child."

But Ye Wanwan was watching Shen Nanzhou's retreating figure and thinking. The Shen Nanzhou of her past life — the one who answered to no one — being held down by Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an while they lectured him... was actually rather—

Refreshing.

And just now, he had clearly noticed Senior Sister moving up behind him. But he hadn't retaliated.

Ye Wanwan turned the disciple token over in her fingers.

She thought — her guess had probably been right all along.

Ye Wanwan spoke up abruptly. "Senior Sister, Senior Brothers — want to divide the spoils?"

Three pairs of eyes lit up at once. Li Wanzhi, who had been faking his injury, leaped to his feet and bolted for the cave entrance. "I'll go drag Fifth Junior Brother back."

Fang He'an called after him: "We'll save him a share when we divide things up — no need to call him!"

Li Wanzhi didn't look back. "Senior Brother, what do you know? If he's not here, how are we supposed to divide his share?"

Fang He'an: "...That is annoyingly reasonable."

Though when Shen Nanzhou did come back and emptied his qiankun pouch to reveal absolutely nothing inside, all four of their faces fell in unison. Li Wanzhi spoke the words that were in everyone's hearts.

"You didn't take a single thing?"

Shen Nanzhou frowned. "Isn't what you took the same thing?"

Li Wanzhi pointed furiously at the floor. "This is the combined haul from after all five of us joined up. Before that, when we were each moving separately, how did you not grab even one treasure?"

Shen Nanzhou glanced briefly at Ye Wanwan. "Didn't get the chance. Someone cleaned everything out at the root."

Ye Wanwan: "......"

Ye Wanwan changed the subject. "Let's start dividing then."

She brought out everything except the core-condensing fruit tree — that tree, while rare, was of no use to Bai Jian and the others, who had already successfully formed their golden cores.

The sight of Ye Wanwan's haul, however, made the other four fall momentarily silent. Shen Nanzhou wasn't particularly surprised, but the looks on Li Wanzhi and Fang He'an's faces were full of disbelief.

"Did you hollow out the entire secret realm?"

Bai Jian also shifted uncomfortably and touched her ring.

She had so little.

What was to be done?

Fang He'an scratched his head. "Dividing it this way isn't fair. Junior Sister, put your things away. We'll count only from the Cloud Mountain Cave onward — what all five of us gathered together — and split that five ways. Everything from before that belongs to whoever claimed it."

Ye Wanwan started to speak.

Fang He'an waved a hand. "I'm Senior Brother, so that's final. You worked hard to get all of that. We're not going to take credit for your effort."

Even Li Wanzhi, who loved money above all else, said: "Right — I may be greedy, but I still have my dignity. There's no such thing as a senior taking from a junior. What's yours is yours. I won't touch it."

Fang He'an: "Exactly. If someone has something they need, we can trade. But nothing for free."

Bai Jian pointed at Fang He'an. "Listen to him."

Ye Wanwan couldn't argue further. She watched as Fang He'an divided up the ores and spirit herbs gathered from the last two locations, using other items to balance out portions that didn't divide evenly into five.

By the end, everyone's share was roughly equal.

Li Wanzhi grinned from ear to ear. "We're rich, we're rich — take these to the spirit market and we can exchange them for plenty of spirit stones."

Fang He'an gave him a smack. "These seven-colored stones can enhance the power of the primordial spirit. You want to sell them! Don't you care about improving your cultivation? And these rare ores are for forging magic tools. And this stalk of body-tempering flame zhi — which everyone specifically yielded to you — and you dare to try and sell it! I'll have Master Uncle come and take a knife to you right now!"

Li Wanzhi: "...I was just saying."

Fang He'an was clearly exasperated. "The ordinary spirit ore can be sold. Everything else stays. Resources go to yourself first."

Li Wanzhi muttered: "I know, I know."

But then Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi each took half of their seven-colored stone fragments and pushed them over to Ye Wanwan's side. Ye Wanwan froze.

Fang He'an said: "We don't know the specifics of your cultivation technique, but before we set out, I asked the Sect Master about what kinds of things would be most useful to you. She said that because the number of golden cores you condense is different from ours, controlling them in the future will require consuming a great deal of primordial spirit energy — so having something that enhances primordial spirit energy would be the most beneficial thing for you."

He paused, then continued: "We discussed it before we went in — if there was anything like that, we'd make sure to get it for you. We got lucky — there happened to be a seven-colored stone deposit in the secret realm, and the three of us went straight there."

It was also because of this shared goal that Bai Jian and the other two, who should have been scattered separately across the secret realm, had ended up converging on the same mining site.

chapters.title: The Reckless Cultivator, Pei Xuan
chapters.content:
Fang He'an looked at Ye Wanwan and said: "Little Junior Sister, you've only just joined the sect, and your seniority is lower than ours — Senior Brother doesn't have much to give you. This is a small gesture from Senior Brother."

"Don't look down on it."

Li Wanzhi nodded. "I kept half for myself, which is enough — my cultivation technique focuses primarily on body tempering, so a little seven-colored stone goes a long way for me. These are for you."

Ye Wanwan didn't know what to say. She didn't dare open her mouth.

Because she had rarely experienced something like this.

It had always been her giving things to others before.

This was the first time anyone had gone out of their way to find what she needed and then give it to her.

She...

Was she allowed to accept it?

Ye Wanwan deliberated for a long while and then shook her head. "I......"

But at that moment, Bai Jian stood up. She walked a few steps forward and, in front of everyone, raised her hand and formed a hand seal. From her storage ring, she retrieved something — and with a heavy thud, a massive boulder more than three zhang tall appeared inside the cave residence.

Bai Jian said: "No yielding. There's enough for everyone."

Ye Wanwan: "......"

Fang He'an and Li Wanzhi's eyes lit up at once. "Right, we almost forgot about this one."

The two rushed over to Bai Jian's side, gesturing at the enormous seven-colored stone. "Look — the three of us, our combined haul!"

Bai Jian looked at Ye Wanwan. "Your stones — Senior Sister has it covered."

Ye Wanwan couldn't help herself and laughed.

Everyone was pleased.

But then Shen Nanzhou, watching Ye Wanwan, set down two items in her hands.

Ye Wanwan froze.

"Wait, let me see!"

Li Wanzhi let out two excited yelps and rushed over. He looked at the items in Ye Wanwan's hands and stared in shock. "This is cinnabar essence stone, and this one is a lightning-struck fossilized wood stone."

"Both over three hundred years old!"

Li Wanzhi drew in two sharp breaths. "These are treasures you couldn't buy on the spirit market even for a high price. Little Junior Brother, where on earth did you get these?"

There was absolutely no way he'd found them in the secret realm.

If the secret realm had things like these, the Xuanming Sect would never have let junior disciples go in to explore.

The quality of these two essence stones was clearly exceptional. Even in a small sect, they could serve as treasured heirlooms passed down through generations. Most importantly, they were supreme tools for talisman cultivators — only a talisman cultivator could bring out their full potential.

"Picked them up on the way," Shen Nanzhou said flatly. He looked at Ye Wanwan. "I've seen that you've been studying the way of talismans. These are useless to me. If you want them, they're yours."

Li Wanzhi dropped to his knees beside Shen Nanzhou, pressing his palms together in the most shameless of pleas. "Senior Brother could also use some — are there any more?"

Shen Nanzhou said coldly: "No. Just the two."

"If she doesn't want them, I'll throw them away."

Li Wanzhi cried out: "Throw them to me! Now!"

Ye Wanwan hugged the two essence stones. "That won't do. Fifth Senior Brother gave these to me — I have to put them to good use."

Shen Nanzhou lowered his eyes. "Mm."

Li Wanzhi was heartbroken.

Had he known Fifth Junior Brother was this wealthy, he would have gotten on his good side long ago. Was it still too late? Was it really too late?

But Ye Wanwan had turned to look at Li Wanzhi. "Speaking of the spirit market — there's actually something I'd like to trouble Fourth Senior Brother with."

Li Wanzhi: "Hm?"

"What kind of trouble?"

......

Wushang Sect. Qingyun Peak.

Ever since Elder Yan Ding had taken up residence on Qingyun Peak and made it his domain, this particular mountain had never been as dead and still as it had been these past few days. Every disciple moved about with an air of dread and dared not raise their voice above a murmur.

And at Miao Lake — ordinarily the liveliest place on the peak, full of laughter and chatter — not a single soul dared to make a sound.

Elder Yu Chun had come several times already and had prescribed medicine, yet Dou Ming still insisted on dragging him back again.

Looking at the injured Dou Ming before him, Yu Chun's tone was sharp with irritation. "I have said it many times — if you don't rest properly, this injury of yours will become a permanent damage. Even a healthy body can't withstand this kind of neglect."

Dou Ming's eyes were bloodshot. "Never mind me — look at Little Junior Sister. Her golden core... it's gone."

Yu Chun's voice went rigid. "I have already said — without a golden core, there is nothing I can do. I'm a healing cultivator who adjusts the body, and I happen to know a bit of restorative technique. For a wound this severe, calling on me is useless."

Dou Ming choked out: "But we don't know who else to turn to. Our master is still in closed cultivation..."

Yu Chun's brow drew tight. "Dou Nephew."

The sudden gravity in his tone made Dou Ming look up in bewilderment.

Yu Chun asked, very deliberately: "When your Seventh Junior Sister's cultivation was destroyed, you weren't like this."

Dou Ming's entire body went rigid.

Yu Chun stared at him carefully, as though reading the confusion and helplessness written across his face, and let out a long sigh. "I watched all of you grow up. The way you all treated her before... wasn't like this."

Dou Ming's hands grew slowly cold. "She's different."

Yu Chun didn't follow. "What?"

"She's a genius. She excels at everything. No matter how difficult a cultivation technique, she only needs a few words and she grasps it. Things that others fight their whole lives for and never obtain — she can claim them the moment she reaches out her hand."

"The marrow-cleansing pool that so many people wanted — she gave it up without a second thought, because she didn't need it in the first place."

"She's different!"

Dou Ming's voice grew steadier with each word. He looked at Yu Chun as though the more firmly he said it, the less wrong he had been.

Word by word, Dou Ming said:

"She was... too dazzling."

Yu Chun stared at Dou Ming, as though he could hardly believe these words had come from him. But the deeper he thought about it, the colder he felt all over. "You were jealous of her?"

Dou Ming didn't dare admit it. "No."

But the more Yu Chun thought about it, the colder he felt. If this wasn't jealousy, then what was it?

Yu Chun had never imagined that behind the harmony and solidarity Qingyun Peak presented to the outside world, they could have been harboring thoughts like this. He probed carefully: "Your eldest senior brother..."

"Did he feel the same way?"

Yu Chun thought — Ji Changhuai wouldn't go that far, surely.

Dou Ming pressed his lips together. "I don't know. But I know..."

Dou Ming's voice dropped very, very low. "Our master was jealous of her too."

Yu Chun was struck dumb.

But the look in Dou Ming's eyes held no trace of a joke.

"A golden core at fifteen years old — too dazzling. A genius like Ye Wanwan was too dazzling." Dou Ming murmured under his breath, and Yu Chun remained in a state of shock all the way until he was pulled to the entrance of Miao Lake, unable to come back to himself.

It was a long while before he gathered his thoughts and examined Ye Qian — but the conclusion was the same.

The golden core had been extracted. There was nothing he could do.

Yu Chun was about to leave, but Dou Ming refused to let him go, pleading with him to find some way to help. But before the plea could be finished, it was interrupted by a detached, unhurried voice.

"So it was jealousy after all."

"Of course. A group of mediocre talents takes in one genius — naturally they'd feel threatened. After all, she was never meant to belong among them."

A clear and cold voice rang out — one that had no business being on Qingyun Peak.

Before Yu Chun and Dou Ming could make sense of it, a figure stepped out of empty space — someone beautiful beyond what seemed possible for a person of this world.

Who was this?

From the direction of the main peak came a thunderous, imposing shout: "Who dares trespass upon our Wushang Sect!"

The man looked up with an indifferent calm. "Pei Xuan."

Yu Chun's face went white.

"It's him!"

The one who had exterminated his entire clan — Pei Xuan!!

The reckless cultivator, Pei Xuan!

chapters.title: She Is My Disciple — My Only Disciple
chapters.content:
A gifted young man who had made a name for himself in the cultivation world at a remarkably young age — yet for reasons unknown, he had been imprisoned by his own clan in an underground dungeon for more than ten years. When he finally got out, his first act was to cut down every last member of his clan with his own hands.

He wiped out his entire bloodline.

And walked away smiling.

That was how Pei Xuan had made his name — a cultivator of noble birth who behaved more like a demonic practitioner than the demonic practitioners themselves. A "reckless" cultivator.

The extermination had been so sensational that the cultivation world at large had once issued an arrest warrant for Pei Xuan, concluding that this person could not be allowed to grow any stronger. Among those he had killed at the time were cultivators in the Deity Transformation stage.

And Pei Xuan at that time had been at the Golden Core stage.

Slaying a Deity Transformation cultivator across two full cultivation stages.

This had sent shockwaves through the entire cultivation world.

Many speculated he must have possessed some rare secret treasure.

So at that time, besieged from all sides, he might also be said to have been constantly fleeing. And then he disappeared.

Vanished from the face of the earth.

It was not until a year later that someone found him at Tianyi Sect, where the previous Sect Master had taken him on as a disciple. Faced with the crowd's demands for answers, the Tianyi Sect Master's response was thoroughly straightforward: "This child has outstanding talent. I hadn't taken on a disciple in many years, so I brought him back with me. If anyone has objections, come to Tianyi Sect and talk to me directly."

The cultivation stage of the Tianyi Sect Master at that time — Tribulation Crossing.

Everyone weighed their own strength against that, recalled Tianyi Sect's particular way of doing things, and gave up unanimously.

Even those who coveted the alleged secret treasure didn't dare provoke Tianyi Sect at that moment.

After all, this sect had a well-earned reputation for being absolutely mad.

They did whatever they pleased, whenever they pleased, with no regard for the rules whatsoever.

Years ago, their founding ancestor Wénxīn, in a fit of rage, had slaughtered all the cultivators in an entire city and exchanged his Ascension-stage cultivation for one word — "true to oneself" — thereby utterly destroying his soul. Even now, not a single major sect dared speak of this matter.

So there had long been a saying in the cultivation world: better to offend the sect masters of three great sects than to cross even a single dog of Tianyi Sect.

Because they were impossible to provoke.

They would genuinely kill you.

Yu Chun recalled all of this about Tianyi Sect, heard the name, and his face had gone rather grim. "He... why would he come down from the mountain?"

There had been an old rumor that Pei Xuan had promised his master he would spend a hundred years in contemplation on the snow mountain and would not descend.

Yu Chun suddenly did the math.

More than a hundred years? Far more!

It had already been three hundred years since Pei Xuan had entered Tianyi Sect.

The legends about him had barely been passed down to this generation of disciples — but Yu Chun had never forgotten them, even though no one had ever known why the Pei clan had imprisoned such a gifted young man in the first place.

But Pei Xuan's ruthlessness was a thing of legend.

His savagery was a thing of legend.

Pei Xuan heard the sound and glanced at Yu Chun. "I didn't think anyone would still recognize me."

Yu Chun hastily clasped his hands and bowed, his voice trembling. "This junior, Yu Chun, greets Senior Pei. We did not know of Senior's arrival and have been poor hosts. May I ask what brings Senior to Wushang Sect?"

By the end of the question, Yu Chun was deeply anxious.

Because — whoever had come, had not come in peace.

Dou Ming stared.

For Yu Chun to address someone as "Senior," that person had to be quite extraordinary.

And yet the one standing before them looked... remarkably young.

Pei Xuan's gaze settled calmly on Miao Lake. "I heard that the original master of this place shared the family name of Ye."

Yu Chun didn't understand the implication, but glancing toward the direction of the main peak where three streaks of light were already flying over, he felt a measure of relief and replied quietly: "The current master also shares the name Ye."

Pei Xuan looked at him sideways, and suddenly smiled.

"And you think those are the same thing?"

"A mediocre talent — what right has she to live in a place this fine?"

Without waiting for Yu Chun to respond.

Spiritual power surged from beneath the man's feet. Ice and snow spread across the ground in an instant, sealing off the entirety of Miao Lake.

Everyone felt the bone-deep cold of midwinter. Ordinarily they were all cultivators — they could circulate their spiritual power to resist the cold, and normal cold weather had long ceased to affect them. But under the pressure of Pei Xuan's power, even Yu Chun felt a terrifying chill seize him.

The entire lake was sealed in ice and snow. A crystalline snowflake drifted down before Pei Xuan's face. He reached out and caught it, and murmured quietly: "Things that don't deserve what they have — should naturally be destroyed."

Crash!

A massive bloom of flame erupted from the depths of Miao Lake, surging outward to swallow the entire frozen lake whole. The water vaporized in a great rush of steam, transforming the lake into something that looked, for a moment, like a celestial realm.

But beneath it all — a hideous, ravaged lakebed lay exposed.

Before anyone could take it in, a searing pulse of fire elements began boiling up from within the depths of the dry lakebed.

Disciples cried out in alarm: "It's lava!"

Molten rock crept upward from the depths, bit by bit.

It swallowed the lakebed.

Then swallowed the buildings before their eyes.

The transformation happened in the blink of an eye. Not only had Yu Chun failed to react, even Dou Ming hadn't. It was only when the entire structure began shaking around them, and screams of pain came from within the building, that Dou Ming snapped back to himself.

"Little Junior Sister!"

Ye Qian had a water spirit root.

Seriously injured as she was, fire was the absolute last thing she could endure.

One misstep, and the fire could destroy Ye Qian from her very foundation.

Dou Ming charged inside and hauled Ye Qian onto his back. Yu Chun was frantic as well. "Senior, surely we can discuss this — at the end of the day, this is Wushang Sect's territory. Conducting yourself this way is harmful to both our sects."

Pei Xuan replied flatly: "I said Pei Xuan. Not Tianyi Sect's Pei Xuan."
